title: Case Manager (78708)
description:
CENTER’S MISSION AND VISION:

Prestera Health Services is devoted to serving our communities by inspiring hope and growth to achieve wellness.

JOB SUMMARY

The Case Manager will provide support through coordinating a variety of services for consumers. Case Managers are responsible for identifying, advocating, linking, and providing crisis services.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conducts interviews with consumers and their legal guardians, as indicated, to collect information need to complete a psychosocial assessment.
  • Works with consumers and other treatment team members following assessment and identification of needs to develop a service/treatment plan within identified time frame.
  • Provides supportive intervention services to consumers, assisting them with practicing skills learned in therapy and making effective use of resources.
  • Schedules service/treatment plan reviews at designated timeframes to review consumer progress and amend the plan as needed.
  • Assesses and reassesses consumer needs by utilizing various screening and assessment tools.
  • Reviews consumer treatment goals and collaborates with other treatment team members.
  • Provides targeted case management services to consumers who qualify, if in need.
  • Assures that pertinent consumer information is shared with other treatment team members to promote quality care.
  • Engages and communicates effectively with consumers and their families/legal guardians, and all team members.
  • Collaborates and plans effectively to access the needed supports and services for each consumer and family served by working with agencies and organizations in a community.
  • Schedules appointments and assures all parties have relevant consents and information needed.
  • Prepares and maintains case records, letters, reports and forms, performs case follow-up and closing, and performs other administrative tasks within established guidelines/timeframes.
  • Works with consumers to promote a positive sense of self-worth and independence.
  • Organizes and conducts support groups for consumers as directed.
  • Advocates for consumers and their families by attending MDT’s, court hearings, IEP/SAT meetings, etc.
  • Utilizes technology provided in order to perform job efficiently and effectively.
  • Arranges for consumer transportation to appointments as needed.
  • Ensures that quality customer services are provided and documented appropriately per policy; utilizes consumer satisfaction surveys with individuals in the program.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of Prestera policies and procedures, and other regulatory bodies governing Prestera’s service delivery, documents according to policies and protocols.
  • Provides crisis assessment, intervention and develops crisis safety plans as indicated.
  • Attends all center meetings/trainings as assigned.
  • Adheres to confidentiality, HIPAA, and risk management policies and procedures including but not limited to completing Incident Reports.
  • Participates in other functional work by participating in related projects, as applicable and directed by Center leadership.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

No direct supervisory responsibilities are required.

title: Accounts Receivables Specialist
description:
Job Summary

Job Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the company's accounts receivable processes, collecting and tracking customer payments, processing bank deposits and maintaining customer records. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of financial concepts and experience with accounting software, making them a key contributor to our financial operations.

Essential Job Functions

  • Payment tracking – monitor customer accounts for timely payments and follow up on past due invoices to ensure cash flow is maintained.
  • Payment application – apply payments received from customers to their accounts in the accounting software.
  • Collections – handle collections by communicating with customers regarding outstanding payments and help resolve billing disputes in coordination with the Billing team.
  • Account reconciliation – reconcile accounts receivable ledger to ensure all payments are properly applied and discrepancies are resolved promptly.
  • Reporting – prepare and analyze accounts receivable reports for management review and providing insights into incoming cash flow.
  • Work closely with the Billing team, Client Services and other internal stakeholders to resolve billing or payment discrepancies, reduce the risk of bad debts, and improve processes.
  • Process check deposits using the remote banking deposit system.
  • Prepare journal entries related to accounts receivable activities.
  • Provide support for internal and external audits.
  • Maintain accurate records of all accounts receivable transactions in accordance with AMS accounting policies.

title: Youth Care Specialist
description:
Residential Services

Position Title: Youth Care Specialist

Location / Shift: Mary Holland Campus, 2:30pm-10:30pm

Starting Pay: $20.00

About CSI

Our story begins in Omaha in 1892, when, due to epidemics, poverty and the difficulties of pioneer life, many children were left in need of parental care. CSI met the need in a revolutionary way – putting the well-being of children first and working to be a voice for the voiceless. We seek to champion children and families by providing the mental, emotional and physical spaces they need to feel empowered and to thrive.

We are looking for someone who has a mind full of wonder and a heart-filled desire to work with little humans! We’re on a mission to champion what’s best for each child and family.

As a Youth Care Specialist in our Shelter at our Mary Holland Campus, you will provide a safe, therapeutic, and learning environment for children and youth ages 12-19. You will provide direct supervision of youth within required program structure and ensure they are having their needs met while they are navigating the challenges at-risk youth endure.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Maintain visual supervision and know where children and youth are at all times through implementation of the program schedule, positive interactions with youth, and participating in activities with the youth.
  • Maintain integrity of the program structure and ensure the therapeutic environment of the program by following the program schedule, helping youth meet outside expectations, and providing learning opportunities and experiences for the youth. Adhere to contractual requirements. Provide medication management according to program procedures.
  • Develop and maintain effective therapeutic relationships by treating youth with respect, providing positive feedback, and displaying empathy.
  • Identify and use opportunities for teaching life skills in everyday activities.
  • Effectively communicate written information (client files, medication logs, pass reports, caseworker calls, etc.) throughout shift to establish and maintain an accurate record of each child’s placement. Maintain accurate records needed by agency (incident reports or restraint reports, etc.)
  • Promote a professional, positive work environment by reporting to shifts, trainings, and meetings on time, following agency protocols, and being flexible to meet client and program needs.
  • Handle crisis using CPI and other techniques in a way that positive therapeutic relationships are maintained.
  • Implement agency Policies and Procedures, licensing, and accreditation standards, and maintain a clean and aesthetic environment.

Other Duties:

  • Perform other duties as directed by supervisor
  • Complete training necessary to perform consistent with program and agency staff development plans including identification of training appropriate to this position; and taking the responsibility for scheduling and attending appropriate training.
  • Complete 24-hour checklist training, defensive driver training, car seat and transportation training and orientation prior to working independently with youth.

Job Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent, Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience in Human Services with children at risk and residential work strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 21 years of age with stamina and temperament to work with youth who are experiencing crisis or emotional behavior disorders.
  • Motor vehicle record of 3 points or less.
  • Must be able to provide proof of active auto insurance.

What You’ll Get:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance options
  • Paid vacation and sick accruals starting day one
  • 401(k) matching up to 5% and fully vested right away
  • 10 paid holidays per year
  • Referral Bonuses
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Discounted, On-Site Childcare Tuition
  • Birthing (up to 6 weeks) & non-birthing (up to 2 weeks) leave at full pay
  • NO NIGHTS AND NO WEEKENDS
  • The opportunity to be a part of a forward-thinking culture!

Be a positive influence on young lives and apply today!

description:
Your Dreams, Our Future.

Join the dynamic and diverse team at Shiseido Americas, a subsidiary of the world-renowned Shiseido Company Limited. Be a part of a portfolio of prestige beauty brands which includes Clé de Peau Beauté, Drunk Elephant, Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare, NARS, SHISEIDO and several prestige fragrance brands including Issey Miyake, Narciso Rodriguez and Tory Burch. At Shiseido Americas we value and celebrate human diversity, with a rich tapestry of employees from all backgrounds and experiences.

Headquartered in New York City with US offices and facilities located in New Jersey, Ohio, Texas and Florida, Shiseido Americas employs over 2,000 individuals in the US, Canada, and Latin America. Shiseido Americas is a hub of talent and innovation. Be inspired by the array of skills, knowledge, and integrity of your colleagues, and join our driving force as Shiseido continues its pursuit of beauty innovations for a better world.

At Shiseido Americas, we focus on our people. We strive to foster a collaborative workplace culture where creative thinking, inclusivity and unique diverse perspectives are celebrated in order to drive success for both our employees and the company as a whole. By prioritizing our team and promoting an open-minded environment, we push the boundaries of what's possible and bring new ideas to life.

WHERE YOU WILL WORK

Without compromising our steadfast commitment to Quality, Safety and Sustainability our manufacturing and packaging facility produces in excess of 70MM units per year. This is a demonstration of our can-do attitude, collaborative spirit, focus on innovation and continuous improvement mindset. Always People First!

JOB SUMMARY

The Automation Technician is responsible for providing technical, mechanical, and operational skills needed to deliver outstanding results in the key areas of the automatic lines, ensuring safety, quality, and efficiency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • You will perform all duties in accordance with company and site-specific safety policies and procedures.
  • You will be responsible for running our automated production lines which include robotics, HMI screens, conveyors, automated packaging equipment, etc.
  • You will troubleshoot and correct system material flow issues.
  • You will troubleshoot basic mechanical, electrical, and computer systems issues and escalate as appropriate.
  • You will set up and verify the functionality and safety of equipment.
  • You will operate production lines and equipment, including safety startup, clearing jams, manual operations, and format changes.
  • You will perform troubleshooting and make necessary process adjustments to improve run time.
  • You will conduct changeovers and equipment adjustments without mechanical support.
  • You will achieve required efficiency and throughput on automated lines.
  • You will measure and record data associated with operating equipment.
  • You can run your own operation, responsibility for all reporting (parts completion reports, downtime reports, etc.).
  • You can work in a team environment.
  • You will support departmental and organizational goals and objectives.
  • You will follow all GMP and Safety requirements.

location: Argentina; Colombia; Peru; Mexico; Dominican Republic
description:
HarZa is a team that has scaled e-commerce brands from zero to 7 and 9 figures. We build and operate direct-to-consumer brands in health and wellness, including Oralux, our oral health brand, and we serve hundreds of thousands of customers through subscriptions and memberships. We are remote-first and async-first, with 150+ people across 15+ countries, and we hold a high standard of ownership in everything we do.

The Role

Retention is one conversation held on two channels. Whether a customer writes in or calls, they are telling you they want out, and your job is the same: read past the request, find the real reason behind it, and answer with the right solution at the right moment. That solution might be a subscription pause, a plan or product change, guidance on using the product correctly, or an approved save offer. When a cancellation is the right call, you process it cleanly and leave the customer with a good last impression.

We run two desks. The email desk is written work: clear, warm, persuasive replies that sound human and never templated, handled end to end within our SLAs. The phone desk is live work: hearing frustration in someone's voice, staying calm, and turning the conversation around in real time without reading from a script. The tasks are identical, the muscle is different.

You apply once. In the first conversation we will ask which desk you want and which one you are actually better at, and if you are strong on both we will tell you where we need you. Having no preference is a perfectly good answer.

What You Will Own

You will handle inbound cancellation, refund and subscription requests end to end, from first contact to resolution, within our SLAs. You will diagnose the real issue behind each request and choose the right retention path using approved save offers, pauses, exchanges and product education. You will handle objections with empathy and confidence, in writing or on a call, without sounding scripted and without applying pressure. When saving is not possible, you will process cancellations, refunds and subscription changes accurately in our CX and subscription platforms. You will document every interaction so anyone on the team can pick it up, and you will tag and report the reasons customers leave so we can fix the problem at the source. Your daily targets are save rate, response time and quality score.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

1+ year in customer support, ideally on a retention, cancellation or save-desk team for a subscription or DTC e-commerce business. Proven comfort handling unhappy customers and turning the conversation around. Experience with helpdesk and subscription tools such as Gorgias, Zendesk, Recharge or Shopify. The ability to keep quality and speed high on a busy queue, and to follow guidelines without sounding robotic. Reliable internet and a quiet home workspace. Experience with health, wellness or oral care customers is a plus, not a requirement.

English, And We Are Specific About It

Your English is evaluated twice in this process, not described. Every candidate completes a written exercise in English. Candidates for the phone desk also have a live conversation in English. For the email desk we need advanced written English: clear, natural and persuasive, with no grammar slips. For the phone desk we need genuinely fluent spoken English, comfortable with US customers and different accents. If your written English is strong but you are not fluent on calls, apply anyway and tell us, the email desk is for you. If your English is intermediate, this is not the right role yet. Please answer the application questions yourself, without AI assistance. We read them closely and we compare them to how you communicate later in the process.

Schedule

Full-time, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, five days a week, including rotating weekend coverage. Training runs on the same schedule.

How We Work

We live by five values, and we hire for them as seriously as we hire for skills: Own It, Make It Count, Find a Way, Master Your Craft, Win Together.

Benefits

What We Offer

Fully remote, international independent contractor (B2B) engagement. Monthly base pay plus a monthly performance bonus tied to retention KPIs. Payments are sent via Wise to any USD account or virtual wallet you use. Paid time off, sick leave, parental leave, and a wellness benefit. Clear KPIs, structured onboarding, and a real growth path into senior retention or team lead roles in a high-growth DTC group.

title: Associate, Investment Onboarding
description:
About this role

Your team

Portfolio Enablement Services supports the operational readiness of portfolios across the investment lifecycle. The team enables portfolio onboarding and restructures, new fund and product launches, entry into new markets, custodian connectivity, trade routing, and the maintenance of settlement and counterparty information. This role offers broad exposure to BlackRock's investment platform and the opportunity to improve how portfolios are implemented at scale.

The team acts as an important connection point between Portfolio Management, Trading, Operations, Technology, global custodians, and other service providers. It maintains critical data and infrastructure supporting trade confirmation, settlement, routing, and straight-through processing, while helping ensure portfolios are appropriately configured on Aladdin.

Your role and impact

As an Associate, you will take ownership of portfolio enablement activities, with a particular focus on supporting portfolios and stakeholders across the Asia-Pacific region. You will coordinate implementation requirements, complete operational controls, resolve issues, and work with global custodians and internal partners to establish trading readiness.

You will also identify opportunities to strengthen controls, increase scalability, and improve service through process enhancement and technology. Working within a global operating model, you will apply collaboration, attention to detail, and sound judgement when managing implementation risks and deadlines.

Your responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

  • Coordinate portfolio lifecycle events, including new fund launches, onboarding and restructures, and establish portfolio configurations and account attributes to validate operational readiness.
  • Partner with global custodians and internal stakeholders to establish market access, standing settlement instructions, trade routing, including managing settlement and counterparty information required for trading readiness.
  • Coordinate inbound and outbound connectivity with custodians and other providers, including Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) and file-based connectivity.
  • Monitor daily workflows and controls, proactively investigate issues, and escalate implementation or operational risks when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve scalability, service levels, automation, and control effectiveness.
  • Collaborate across Portfolio Management, Trading, Technology, Operations, custodians and service providers while contributing to global procedures, cross-training, business continuity and audit readiness.

Your experience

  • Typically 2–5 years of relevant experience in investment operations, asset management, custody, securities services, or a related financial-services environment, consistent with the Associate level.
  • Knowledge of the investment lifecycle, financial products, portfolio structures and global market infrastructure, including portfolio setup, trade confirmation and settlement.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to assess risk, prioritize competing workflows and deliver accurately within deadlines.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with experience collaborating across internal teams and global custodians on market openings, settlement instructions, trade routing or portfolio onboarding.
  • Strong data and digital fluency, including intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills and familiarity with SQL, data analysis or workflow-automation tools, with an interest in using automation and AI-enabled tools to improve operational outcomes.
  • Experience with the Aladdin platform or comparable investment-management technology.
  • Experience supporting Asia-Pacific markets or working within a global operational model.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior AI/ML Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

Senior AI/ML Data Engineer


The Senior AI/ML Data Engineer owns the production pipelines that turn unstructured text and documents into reliable, model-ready data for our team's Generative AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications and services. Key focus areas will include engineering data products built from licensed scientific literature, patents, clinical trials, and more. You'll build and maintain ingestion and parsing pipelines for unstructured or semi-structured text data with data-quality checks built in, govern data lineage and usage compliance for AI applications, and configure the search indices built on this data. You'll also build shared pipeline components and deployment patterns used across the team. These data products support critical use cases spanning early-stage scientific research to post-market surveillance, including systematic literature reviews, competitive intelligence, target identification, and safety monitoring.


You'll work directly alongside the data scientists and scientific subject matter experts who use your data. You will have the autonomy to propose better ways to build, see your work accelerate research, and ultimately help bring therapeutics to patients. As you grow, you'll have opportunities to expand into emerging areas, such as large language model (LLM)-powered document parsing and metadata enrichment. The position is embedded within a cross-disciplinary team of data scientists, bioinformaticians, and engineers dedicated to using cutting-edge AI/ML and data science techniques to drive drug discovery and development.


What you will:

  • Pipeline delivery: Build and run production pipelines hands-on that turn unstructured text into reliable data products, and drive the technical execution of complex data initiatives
  • Requirements validation: Partner closely with stakeholders to clarify requirements and critically examine them for assumptions, feasibility, consistency, and completeness throughout the design lifecycle
  • Engineering standards: Shape modern data engineering practices across the team, including pipeline design patterns, data modeling conventions, schema governance, and resource optimization
  • Solution design: Write technical specifications that weigh architectural options, trade-offs, and risks, recommending the best-fit tools and approaches
  • Data quality and reliability: Embed automated validation checks, dataset versioning, and pipeline monitoring across data products, and establish robust data lineage to ensure traceability
  • Pipeline maintenance: Maintain and continuously improve production pipelines through dependency and platform upgrades, refactoring, and technical debt reduction
  • Data partnerships: Coordinate with upstream data providers and downstream data consumers to establish data contracts, dependencies, and validation datasets
  • ML productionization: Partner with the MLOps team to turn experimental ML pipelines into robust, production-grade workflows
  • AI-enabled development: Integrate coding agents into team workflows, such as automated pipeline-failure triage and fixes, with appropriate human oversight
  • Knowledge building: Mentor team members through design discussions and constructive code reviews, and translate technical knowledge into clear, comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials


What you should have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering
  • 3+ years of experience building and operating production-scale data pipelines using Python, SQL, and Spark (or similar distributed frameworks)
  • Experience with workflow orchestration and CI/CD tools (e.g. Airflow, GitHub Actions)
  • Experience processing semi-structured or unstructured text data (e.g. XML, JSON, or scanned documents) in production environments


What we offer:

  • Exciting work in a great team, global projects, international environment
  • Opportunity to learn and grow professionally within the company globally
  • Hybrid working model, flexible role pattern
  • Competitive salary & incentive pay
  • Pension and health insurance contributions

title: Senior Associate, GHG Data Specialist
description:
Role Purpose and Impact

This role contributes to the delivery, evolution and disclosure of LSEG’s Climate Transition Plan.


Working in the Group Sustainability team this role plays a critical role in the delivery of our climate strategy.


You will be working in partnership with key stakeholders across Operations, Technology, Procurement, Finance and Group Risk to oversee and drive GHG data collection, quality and disclosure to support our broader climate transition plan and targets.


With an ever-changing climate-related landscape this role is central to ensuring LSEG maintains a sector-leading approach on climate, consistent with LSEG’s ambition to be a sustainability leader.

Key Responsibilities

  • GHG Data calculation: Undertake GHG data calculation within a GHG management tool (using provided consumption spend and activitiy data) in line with Basis of Preparation documents owned by Climate Team.
  • GHG Inventory: Collate a consolidated GHG inventory across all emissions on a quarterly basis to support management decisions.
  • Data Quality: Perform monthly data validation checks on emissions data – variance analysis, completeness checks, double counting and omission check, unit/format checks, emission factor validation.
  • Controls: Collate end-to-end source documentation to support all emission calculations, in preparation for auditor requests, and ensure entered GHG data tool.
  • Reporting: Produce quarterly reporting packs and KPI tracking with variance commentary.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Work with data owners on a monthly basis to support the collation of consumption data, spot variances and anomalies, and translate the data into emissions through the GHG management system.
  • System implementation: assist with the implementation of a new GHG tool.

Technical / job functional knowledge

  • Working knowledge of Greenhouse Gas Protocol, emissions categorisation experience.
  • Strong data management and analytical skills.

Business and sector expertise

  • Strong climate and environmental sustainability experience is essential.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail required.
  • Strong stakeholder relationship skills to develop effective relationships across LSEG as required to perform the role.

The role

The role focuses on providing technical product advice, equipment selection, application engineering, quotation preparation and project support to external sales teams, distributors, contractors, consultants and builders.   • Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Building Services or a related discipline, or a Refrigeration & Air Conditioning trade qualification with relevant industry experience.

title: DevOps Software Engineer - Fuzzing Infrastructure, SEAR
description:
As part of Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture (SEAR) organization, you'll join our mission to create the world's most secure products. We build groundbreaking tools that empower our security researchers to deeply analyze Apple's codebases and frameworks and surface security concerns efficiently and at scale.

Fuzzing is one of the most effective ways we find vulnerabilities before attackers do. We are building the next generation of our fuzzing infrastructure, and we are seeking a DevOps Software Engineer to help develop it, deploy it, and keep it running reliably for the teams that depend on it. By combining infrastructure and software development, you will directly contribute to our mission to create the world's most secure products.

A strong candidate for this role is passionate about building reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure that directly amplifies security research impact. You will work closely with security researchers and fuzzing engineers, located worldwide, on a new fuzzing platform that runs large fleets of fuzzing jobs across heterogeneous targets, from userland libraries to full-system and device fuzzing.

You will take part in the complete journey: from architecture and implementation of the platform's core services, through build and deployment, to ongoing reliable operation. You will help migrate existing fuzzing campaigns onto the new platform and make it simple for researchers to onboard new targets.

On the development side, you will contribute to the platform's services, APIs, and integrations, and harden research code for scale. On the infrastructure side, you will design containerized deployments, establish CI/CD pipelines, implement secrets management and access controls, and build the monitoring and observability that tell us whether campaigns are actually making progress (coverage, throughput, crash rates, worker health).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience designing and operating cloud and on-premises service infrastructure, with advanced knowledge of containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data storage, networking, authentication/authorization (OIDC, OAuth), queuing, logging, and monitoring.
  • Advanced knowledge of scripting and programming languages, including Python and Bash.
  • Familiarity with fuzzing concepts and tooling (e.g., AFL++, libFuzzer, coverage-guided fuzzing, sanitizers, crash triage and deduplication)
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and the ability to work autonomously and collaboratively across teams and organizations in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating security research tooling, or large-scale batch/distributed compute systems
  • Experience with and/or strong enthusiasm for security, especially offensive security
  • Experience with large-scale data pipelines and storage systems (corpora, crash artifacts, coverage data)
  • Familiarity with AI/ML workflows and agents

• Inspect high-precision machined and fine-mechanical components using optical instruments and specialized measurement tools.

title: Senior AI/ML Platform Engineer (Cloud & DevOps)
description:
Job Description

Senior AI/ML Platform Engineer (Cloud & DevOps)


The Senior AI/ML Platform Engineer owns the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and platform tooling behind our team's Generative AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications and services. Key focus areas will include maintaining and evolving AWS Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD for our data pipelines, APIs, and applications; secure data transfer from external content providers; self-service hosting patterns that let data scientists and developers easily put their work in front of users; and operating infrastructure services such as OpenSearch. This platform supports critical use cases spanning early-stage scientific research to post-market surveillance, including systematic literature reviews, competitive intelligence, target identification, and safety monitoring.


You'll work directly alongside the data scientists and engineers who use the platform. You will have the autonomy to propose and try new tools, see your work streamline complex workflows, and ultimately help bring therapeutics to patients. As you grow, you'll have opportunities to expand into emerging areas, such as infrastructure for AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. The position is embedded within a cross-disciplinary team of data scientists, bioinformaticians, and engineers dedicated to using cutting-edge AI/ML and data science techniques to drive drug discovery and development.


What you will do:

  • Developer platform: Build self-service paths that let data scientists and developers ship their work to users quickly, leveraging shared enterprise platforms or custom AWS infrastructure as needed, and drive development of complex platform initiatives
  • Requirements validation: Partner closely with stakeholders to clarify requirements and critically examine them for assumptions, feasibility, consistency, and completeness throughout the design lifecycle
  • Platform standards: Shape easy-to-follow infrastructure, CI/CD, and operational standards across the team
  • Solution design: Write technical specifications that weigh architectural options, trade-offs, and risks, recommending the best-fit tools and approaches
  • Reliable delivery: Make builds and releases fast, secure, and repeatable, with reviews, automated quality gates, and change control
  • Cloud environments: Provision, scale, patch, and upgrade environments, and lead cost, capacity, and performance tuning across our cloud footprint
  • Operational excellence: Track site reliability engineering (SRE) metrics against the team's reliability targets, and run monitoring, issue triage, and root cause analysis to keep applications highly available
  • AI-enabled operations: Integrate agents into platform operations, such as automated alert triage, incident diagnosis, and automated fixes for failed builds, with appropriate human oversight
  • Knowledge building: Mentor team members through design discussions and constructive infrastructure and code reviews, and translate technical knowledge into clear, comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials


What you should have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in cloud, DevOps, or platform engineering
  • 3+ years of experience authoring Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) to provision resources and deploy workloads on a major cloud provider (AWS preferred)
  • Experience owning production operations, including infrastructure monitoring and incident management
  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience


What we offer:

  • Exciting work in a great team, global projects, international environment
  • Opportunity to learn and grow professionally within the company globally
  • Hybrid working model, flexible role pattern
  • Competitive salary & incentive pay
  • Pension and health insurance contributions
  • Internal reward system and referral scheme
  • 5 weeks annual leave, 5 sick days, 15 days of certified sick leave paid above statutory requirements annually, 40 paid hours annually for volunteering activities, 12 weeks of parental contribution
  • Cafeteria for tax free benefits according to your choice (meal vouchers, sport, culture, health, travel, etc.), Multisport Card
  • Vodafone, Raiffeisen Bank, Foodora, and discount programs
  • Up-to-date laptop and iPhone
  • Parking in the garage, showers, refreshments, massage chairs, library, music corner


Additional job details

In addition to building and maintaining our suite of tools, our team consults on how software capabilities, data products, and AI/ML can support the projects of our 5,000+ stakeholders (scientists, engineers, regulatory liaisons, data scientists, etc.) across our multi-national organization. We strive to enhance data science, NLP, and AI literacy across these groups.


As part of our work, our team has opportunities to coauthor internal and external presentations, white papers, manuscripts, and/or open-source code releases. We invest in your professional growth by providing access to specialized learning platforms, opportunities to attend industry conferences, participation in internal communities of practice, and the chance to learn the science of drug discovery and development directly from domain experts.

Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cloud Networking, Data Engineering, Design Applications, Generative AI, Git, GitHub, Information Systems, Machine Learning (ML), Python (Programming Language), Shell Scripting, Software Development, System Designs, System Integration, Testing

title: Junior AI & Automation Specialist
description:
We are looking for a technically curious, proactive and results-driven Junior AI & Automation Specialist to support our business operations while helping us transition towards an AI-first operating model.

This is a hands-on role combining everyday operational responsibilities with the development of intelligent workflows, automation systems and AI employees.

You will initially carry out assigned tasks manually, understand and document how they work, then investigate how AI and automation can improve or take over suitable activities.

A major part of your role will be to design, create, train, test, deploy and continuously improve AI employees (AI agents) capable of assisting different departments, including HR, Recruitment, Sales, Marketing, Operations and Quality Control.

You will remain accountable for assigned operational outcomes throughout this process.

Our philosophy: Do it. Understand it. Improve it. Automate it. Own it.

Requirements

1. Business Operations & Administrative Coordination

  • Carry out assigned daily administrative and operational responsibilities.
  • Monitor ClickUp tasks, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Coordinate routine work and follow up with staff to ensure completion.
  • Support recruitment administration, employee onboarding and attendance monitoring.
  • Assist with reporting, documentation, quality checks and general administration.
  • Ensure all assigned operational tasks continue to be completed while improvements or automations are being developed.

2. AI Employee (AI Agent) Development & Management

One of your core responsibilities will be to create and continuously develop AI employees that support, automate and improve business functions.

You will:

  • Identify business roles, activities and workflows suitable for AI assistance or automation.
  • Design and develop AI employees for departments such as HR, Recruitment, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance and Quality Control.
  • Define each AI employee's responsibilities, objectives, instructions, workflows, knowledge sources and performance expectations.
  • Use AI platforms, agent-building tools, APIs, integrations and automation technologies to develop functional AI employees.
  • Provide AI employees with approved company procedures, documentation, knowledge bases and relevant business information.
  • Connect AI employees to authorised business applications and workflows
  • Enable AI employees to perform appropriate activities such as preparing reports, monitoring tasks, drafting communications, researching information and recommending follow-up actions.
  • Test AI employees using realistic scenarios and verify the accuracy, reliability and quality of their outputs.
  • Monitor AI employee performance, identify weaknesses, investigate errors and continuously improve instructions, knowledge and workflows.
  • Develop safeguards, approval requirements and escalation procedures for activities requiring human oversight.
  • Maintain documentation, performance records and version histories for each AI employee.
  • Gradually expand the capabilities and responsibilities of AI employees as they demonstrate consistent, measurable reliability.
  • Ensure AI employees operate securely, protect confidential information and comply with company policies and applicable data protection requirements.

The objective is not simply to create an AI agent, but to develop a reliable digital team member that delivers measurable business value and improves over time.

3. AI, Automation & Process Improvement

  • Identify repetitive manual tasks and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Map existing workflows and document business requirements.
  • Investigate automation options using AI-assisted development, APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code platforms.
  • Build automated task assignments, reminders, reporting workflows and notifications.
  • Develop dashboards, internal tools and AI-assisted applications.
  • Test solutions against existing processes before deployment.
  • Monitor live workflows, troubleshoot failures and maintain reliable operations.
  • Evaluate new technologies based on their practical business value.

4. Quality Control & Operational Monitoring

  • Review jobs, documentation, administrative work and records for quality and completeness.
  • Identify missing information, delays, inaccuracies and recurring operational problems.
  • Monitor task completion, communication standards and process compliance.
  • Develop AI-assisted checks to support quality control and exception monitoring.
  • Verify automated results and escalate material discrepancies.

5. Business Systems, Data & Reporting

  • Work with ClickUp, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, recruitment platforms, HR systems and other business applications.
  • Learn unfamiliar systems independently using documentation, research and approved AI tools.
  • Prepare operational reports, trackers and performance dashboards.
  • Maintain accurate records, data consistency and workflow documentation.
  • Develop automated reporting and monitoring capabilities where practical.

Operational Ownership & Accountability

carry out assigned operational and administrative responsibilities while actively exploring opportunities to improve or automate those processes.

Developing an automation or AI employee does not suspend responsibility for completing the underlying work.

Until an automated process or AI employee has been successfully tested, approved and implemented, the employee remains responsible for ensuring the existing process continues to operate correctly.

Once implemented, the employee will monitor the automated workflow or AI employee, investigate exceptions, resolve issues within their authority and ensure continuity when automation fails.

Human approval must remain in place for sensitive, high-risk or consequential decisions, including employment decisions, disciplinary action, payments and other activities requiring authorised judgement.

Who We're Looking For

We welcome fresh graduates, early-career professionals and self-taught technology enthusiasts.

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

  • Have a genuine passion for artificial intelligence and automation.
  • Enjoy experimenting with AI tools and building practical solutions.
  • Are capable of learning unfamiliar technologies independently.
  • Can combine everyday operational work with technical development.
  • Demonstrate strong logical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and communicate proactively.
  • Have good written and spoken English.
  • Are organised, reliable and attentive to detail.
  • Are comfortable using digital tools, researching solutions and working remotely.

Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Make, Zapier, n8n, AI agent platforms, APIs or basic programming would be advantageous but is not essential.

Benefits

  • Access to approved premium AI tools and business software.
  • Practical training and opportunities to develop technical skills.
  • Hands-on experience building real AI employees and automations.
  • Opportunities to work across multiple business departments.
  • Long-term career progression into AI Automation, Business Systems and AI Operations roles.

title: Resident Service Coordinator - Providence Gardens
description:
Who We Are

Redwood Communities, Inc. (“Redwood Communities”), an affiliate of Redwood Housing, is a multifamily property management organization that manages affordable housing communities throughout the country. To date, Redwood Communities has assembled a best-in-class team that currently manages a growing portfolio of properties and has built strong working relationships with government agencies and leading non-profit organizations to raise the standard of living for our communities.

Benefits

  • Exceptional medical benefits: We cover more than 90% of medical premiums, and employees have the option of a 100% employer-paid HSA medical plan.
  • 100% company paid dental and vision benefits for employee coverage.
  • Healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts.
  • Company paid life insurance, AD&D
  • Best-in-class voluntary insurance benefits.
  • Pre-tax and Roth 401(k) programs with a company match equal to 100% of the first 6% contributed by the employee.
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) with 24/7 counseling services.
  • 3 weeks of paid time off each year.
  • 12 paid holidays each year & 2 floating holidays.

About the Position

The Resident Services Coordinator (RSC) helps residents access services, strengthen housing stability, and remain as independent and self-reliant as possible. The RSC assesses non-clinical needs, coordinates referrals and supportive services, develops community partnerships and resident programming, and maintains accurate, secure, and timely documentation. The role works proactively with residents, property teams, community partners, supervisors, and leadership while respecting resident choice, dignity, privacy, and individual goals.

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-5pm

Pay Details: $26.50-$28.50/hour

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Resident Support & Advocacy:

  • Serve as a connector, coordinator, educator, advocate, and documenter for residents while maintaining clear professional boundaries.
  • Maintain a visible, proactive presence with clear office hours and ongoing professional relationships with residents.
  • Conduct resident intake and non-clinical assessments to identify priorities, risks, strengths, activities of daily living, and service needs without diagnosing.
  • Develop or update resident services plans collaboratively with participating residents; respect and document a resident’s decision to decline participation.
  • Provide general or limited case management when appropriate and when the needed service is not otherwise available through the larger service community.
  • Assist residents in accessing public benefits and supportive resources, including food, health coverage, income supports, energy assistance, transportation, and other locally available services.
  • Make referrals with resident permission, obtain signed consent before sharing protected information, and follow up to determine whether services were timely, appropriate, and responsive to the resident’s need.
  • Advocate and, when appropriate, negotiate on behalf of residents for adequate, timely, and cost-effective services while avoiding unhealthy dependence.

Program Development and Community Partnerships

  • Develop and coordinate educational, wellness, prevention, employment-readiness, and community-engagement activities based on identified resident needs.
  • Coordinate on-site services, screenings, clinics, workshops, speakers, volunteer opportunities, resident meetings, resource fairs, and community-building activities.
  • Build productive relationships with local, state, and federal agencies, nonprofit organizations, service providers, and volunteer groups.
  • Maintain a current resource directory that identifies who each provider serves, referral procedures, consent requirements, follow-up steps, and options when access barriers arise; update it at least annually and whenever provider information changes.
  • Identify service gaps, pursue additional resources, and elevate barriers that limit resident access or program effectiveness.
  • Strengthen informal support networks among residents and with families, as appropriate and with resident consent.

Documentation, Privacy and Reporting

  • Maintain complete, objective, prompt, organized, and secure resident case files consistent with HUD requirements and company policy.
  • Document intake information, assessments, services plans, resident contacts, referrals, consent, participation or refusal, follow-up, progress notes, and disposition or termination of services in the approved case-management system.
  • Maintain program records, including training documentation, reports, provider agreements, program files, eligible expense records, and other required supporting documentation.
  • If applicable, prepare accurate internal and HUD-required reports, including the HUD Multifamily Housing Service Coordinator Program Annual Report (HUD Form 92456).
  • Protect resident privacy and share resident-specific information only when authorized, necessary, and consistent with HUD, HIPAA, Fair Housing, organizational confidentiality, consent, and records-security requirements.
  • Take immediate action to correct missing, late, inaccurate, or insecure documentation and participate in file reviews and quality-assurance activities.

Communication, Collaboration and Escalation

  • Maintain strong communication and collaboration with property staff, supervisors, service providers, and quality assurance partners to address resident needs, service gaps, risks, and housing stability concerns.
  • Work closely with property management while appropriately referring leasing, rent collection, maintenance, and enforcement matters to their team, and coordinating interventions for residents at risk of eviction or housing instability.
  • Promptly escalate safety, abuse, neglect, or legal concerns according to protocol, while meeting all training, reporting, documentation, and professional responsiveness requirements.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Complete at least 36 hours of initial training before hiring or within 12 months of the initial hire date. Topics include aging, federal and state programs, elder and disability services, legal liability, substance use, and mental health.
  • Knowledge of HUD Multifamily housing programs, Section 8, service coordinator funding requirements, Fair Housing, reasonable accommodations, and confidentiality obligations.
  • Knowledge of older-adult and disability services, supportive housing, public benefits, local resources, referral processes, and federal and state entitlement programs.
  • Ability to conduct non-clinical assessments, facilitate services, organize programs, solve problems, advocate effectively, and achieve documented results.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, presentation, organization, follow-up, and professional communication skills.
  • Cultural competency and bilingual skills when relevant to the resident population.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, maintain professional boundaries, and use sound judgment in standardized and urgent situations.
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, online time keeping and training, shared files, and approved resident or case-management systems.

title: Principal Scientist - Medicinal Chemistry
description:
Career Category

Scientific

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Principal Scientist - Medicinal Chemistry


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will part of an innovative Medicinal Chemistry group, with responsibilities including (but not limited to) the design, synthesis, and purification of novel compounds for potential clinical drug development. This will also include the opportunity to work within Amgen’s Induced Proximity Platform (IPP), which is focused on novel and innovative approaches to modulate intractable targets in diseases using the emerging PROTAC modality.

title: Civil Pipe Forman
description:
Lead from the trench. Build infrastructure that lasts. Gulf Operators is looking for a Civil Pipe Foreman who takes pride in leading crews, delivering quality work, and maintaining safe, well-organized job sites. From water and sewer systems to storm drainage and underground utilities, you will turn plans into progress, coordinate daily pipe activities, solve field challenges, and help deliver critical civil infrastructure.

  • Put Safety First - Lead by example and ensure work is completed safely, responsibly, and in accordance with company policies, project requirements, and safe excavation and trenching practices.
  • Plan the Day - Turn drawings, specifications, pipe profiles, grades, and project plans into clear daily work activities, safety plans, GPS, and crew requirements.
  • Lead in the Field - Direct pipe crews, operators, labourers, and subcontractors, set clear priorities, and keep work moving safely and productively.
  • Install It Right - Coordinate excavation, trenching, bedding, pipe installation, structures, backfill, compaction, testing, and restoration activities.
  • Keep Everyone Connected - Communicate daily priorities, field conditions, utility conflicts, material requirements, and progress with crews, supervision, survey, and project management.
  • Manage Production - Track daily quantities, labour, equipment, materials, and productivity to support project cost and production targets.
  • Deliver Quality - Ensure pipe grades, elevations, slopes, bedding, installation, compaction, and testing meet drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
  • Lead with Accountability - Set clear expectations, coach your team, and drive results in Safety, Quality, Cost, Schedule, and Production.
  • Education - High school diploma or equivalent required. Technical or college training is an asset.
  • Experience - 5+ years of civil pipe or underground utility construction experience, with previous Foreman, Lead Hand, or field leadership experience considered an asset.
  • Leadership - Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and crew leadership skills.
  • Civil Pipe Knowledge - Experience with watermain, sanitary sewer, storm sewer, drainage systems, manholes, catch basins, excavation, trenching, bedding, backfill, and compaction.
  • Drawings & Grades - Ability to read and understand construction drawings, pipe profiles, grades, elevations, slopes, and specifications.
  • Technology - Comfortable with Microsoft 365; experience with Microsoft Project, B2W Track, Bluebeam Revu, GPS, and machine control technology is an asset.
  • Certifications & Licensing - Valid driver's license required; related technical training and certifications are assets.

What’s in it for You?

  • Build Your Career - Grow through hands-on field experience, mentorship, technical training, and professional development opportunities.
  • Make Your Mark - Lead pipe crews in the field and take pride in seeing your team's work become critical infrastructure that serves communities and customers.
  • Work That Keeps You Engaged - Work across a variety of challenging civil and underground utility projects, solving field problems and continuing to build your expertise.
  • Build Your Community - Help deliver water, sewer, drainage, and other infrastructure that supports the communities where we live and work, while having opportunities to get involved and give back.
  • Competitive Pay & Benefits - Enjoy industry-leading compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.

Ready to Lead in the Field?

If you are an experienced civil pipe foreman who takes pride in leading crews and delivering safe, productive, and quality underground utility work, we would like to hear from you. Apply today and build your next chapter with Gulf Operators.

title: QA & Automation Engineer - AI/ML applications
description:
Job Description

QA & Automation Engineer for AI/ML applications


The Quality Assurance (QA) & Automation Engineer for AI/ML applications automates and runs the tests that keep our team's Generative AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications and services reliable and correct. Key focus areas will include automated testing of our search, exploration, and AI agent applications, and of data-serving APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, to support releases as they move to production. You'll also build end-to-end regression tests for the data products behind them, feeding mock source data through the pipelines and verifying results through their APIs. These products support critical use cases spanning early-stage scientific research to post-market surveillance, including systematic literature reviews, competitive intelligence, target identification, and safety monitoring.


You'll be mentored by experienced engineers and work directly alongside developers, data scientists, and scientific subject matter experts. You'll help shape a growing quality practice, see your work keep critical tools reliable, and ultimately help bring therapeutics to patients. As you grow, you'll have opportunities to step into Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)-level engineering, covering test infrastructure, advanced framework design, and automated CI/CD gating. The position is embedded within a cross-disciplinary team of data scientists, bioinformaticians, and engineers dedicated to using cutting-edge AI/ML and data science techniques to drive drug discovery and development.


Your responsibilities

  • Requirements validation: Participate in requirements reviews, check for testability and gaps, and assist in defining clear test cases and acceptance criteria
  • UI test automation: Build and maintain automated end-to-end UI tests for our web applications that run in CI/CD pipelines and cover critical user workflows, working closely with developers
  • API testing: Build and maintain automated API and integration tests for our REST APIs and MCP servers, including contract tests, to catch issues early
  • Release confidence: Execute test runs, validate releases, and apply quality gates to keep defects out of production
  • Data product testing: Build mock datasets and end-to-end regression tests that verify data pipelines and their downstream APIs before release
  • Quality insights: Assist in tracking and reporting quality metrics, such as defect leakage, test coverage, and test suite reliability
  • Shaping the practice: Contribute to the team's QA strategy, adoption of test automation tooling, and maintenance of testing frameworks
  • AI-assisted testing: Use coding agents to generate and extend tests, verify that they test the right behavior and edge cases, and contribute to the team's agent-assisted test workflows


What you should have

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software testing, QA engineering, or test automation
  • 2+ years of experience writing and maintaining automated test suites integrated into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience automating tests for web applications and REST APIs


What we offer:

  • Exciting work in a great team, global projects, international environment
  • Opportunity to learn and grow professionally within the company globally
  • Hybrid working model, flexible role pattern
  • Competitive salary & incentive pay
  • Pension and health insurance contributions
  • Internal reward system and referral scheme
  • 5 weeks annual leave, 5 sick days, 15 days of certified sick leave paid above statutory requirements annually, 40 paid hours annually for volunteering activities, 12 weeks of parental contribution
  • Cafeteria for tax free benefits according to your choice (meal vouchers, sport, culture, health, travel, etc.), Multisport Card
  • Vodafone, Raiffeisen Bank, Foodora, and discount programs
  • Up-to-date laptop and iPhone
  • Parking in the garage, showers, refreshments, massage chairs, library, music corner

Additional job details

In addition to building and maintaining our suite of tools, our team consults on how software capabilities, data products, and AI/ML can support the projects of our 5,000+ stakeholders (scientists, engineers, regulatory liaisons, data scientists, etc.) across our multi-national organization. We strive to enhance data science, NLP, and AI literacy across these groups.


As part of our work, our team has opportunities to coauthor internal and external presentations, white papers, manuscripts, and/or open-source code releases. We invest in your professional growth by providing access to specialized learning platforms, opportunities to attend industry conferences, participation in internal communities of practice, and the chance to learn the science of drug discovery and development directly from domain experts.


Additional location(s) Compensation Information:

Required Skills:

Automated Testing, Automation Frameworks, Data Visualization, Generative AI, Git, Integration Testing, Large Language Models (LLMs), RESTful APIs, Software Development, System Designs, Testing, Test Scenarios, UI Test Automation, User Interface Testing

title: Intellectual Property Officer
description:
• Prepare, file, and monitor trademark, copyright, patent, and industrial design applications with DJKI, and support international filings (Madrid Protocol, PCT) with foreign counsel and consultants
  • Conduct trademark clearance and prior-art searches, summarize risks, and respond to office actions and oppositions within statutory deadlines
  • Review IP-related agreements (NDAs, license, development, distribution, collaboration, consultancy, employment), identify IP risks, and propose revisions
  • Maintain the IP register, powers of attorney, and files, and track renewals, annuities, and recordals
  • Monitor marketplaces, social media, and domain names for infringement, and assist with cease-and-desist letters, takedowns, and enforcement matters with external counsel
  • Support IP due diligence and third-party infringement risk checks for partnerships and new products
  • Serve as the IP point of contact for internal teams, guide proper use of company brands and third-party content, and contribute to IP policies and awareness sessions
  • Prepare periodic reports on portfolio status, costs, and ongoing matters

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law (S.H.)
  • 2-3 years of IP experience in a law firm, IP consultancy, or in-house team (fresh graduates with IP internships or coursework may be considered)
  • Understanding of Indonesian IP law and the DJKI filing process; knowledge of Madrid Protocol and PCT is a plus
  • Ability to review contracts with close attention to IP clauses
  • Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple deadlines




Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan (Responsibilities)

- Menyiapkan, mengajukan, dan memantau permohonan pendaftaran merek dagang, hak cipta, paten, dan desain industri kepada Direktorat Jenderal Kekayaan Intelektual (DJKI), serta mendukung proses pendaftaran internasional (Madrid Protocol dan PCT) melalui koordinasi dengan konsultan dan penasihat hukum di luar negeri.

- Melakukan pemeriksaan kelayakan pendaftaran merek dagang (trademark clearance) dan penelusuran paten terdahulu (prior-art search), merangkum potensi risiko, serta menanggapi surat keberatan atau penolakan dari DJKI (office actions) dan oposisi dalam batas waktu yang ditentukan oleh peraturan perundang-undangan.

- Meninjau perjanjian yang berkaitan dengan kekayaan intelektual, seperti NDA (Perjanjian Kerahasiaan), perjanjian lisensi, pengembangan, distribusi, kolaborasi, konsultasi, dan ketenagakerjaan; mengidentifikasi risiko terkait kekayaan intelektual serta mengusulkan revisi yang diperlukan.

- Memelihara dan memperbarui daftar aset kekayaan intelektual (IP Register), surat kuasa, serta dokumen terkait, termasuk memantau jadwal perpanjangan masa perlindungan, pembayaran biaya pemeliharaan paten (annuity), dan pencatatan perubahan data atau kepemilikan (recordals).

- Memantau marketplace, media sosial, dan nama domain untuk mendeteksi potensi pelanggaran hak kekayaan intelektual, serta membantu penanganan melalui surat teguran (cease-and-desist letters), permintaan penghapusan konten (takedown), dan tindakan penegakan hukum bersama penasihat hukum eksternal.

- Mendukung proses uji tuntas kekayaan intelektual (IP Due Diligence) serta pemeriksaan risiko pelanggaran hak kekayaan intelektual pihak ketiga dalam kerja sama bisnis dan pengembangan produk baru.

- Menjadi narahubung utama terkait kekayaan intelektual bagi seluruh tim internal, memberikan arahan mengenai penggunaan merek perusahaan dan konten milik pihak ketiga secara tepat, serta berkontribusi dalam penyusunan kebijakan dan program sosialisasi terkait kekayaan intelektual.

- Menyusun laporan berkala mengenai status portofolio kekayaan intelektual, biaya, serta perkembangan berbagai perkara atau proses yang sedang berjalan.

Persyaratan (Requirements)

- Pendidikan minimal Sarjana Hukum (S.H.).

- Memiliki pengalaman 2–3 tahun di bidang Kekayaan Intelektual (Intellectual Property/IP), baik di kantor hukum, konsultan kekayaan intelektual, maupun tim hukum internal perusahaan (in-house legal team). Lulusan baru dengan pengalaman magang atau mata kuliah terkait kekayaan intelektual dapat dipertimbangkan.

- Memahami peraturan perundang-undangan terkait kekayaan intelektual di Indonesia serta proses pengajuan pendaftaran melalui DJKI. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai Madrid Protocol dan Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) menjadi nilai tambah.

- Mampu melakukan peninjauan dan analisis kontrak dengan memperhatikan secara detail klausul-klausul yang berkaitan dengan kekayaan intelektual.

- Fasih berbahasa Inggris dan Bahasa Indonesia, baik lisan maupun tulisan.

- Teliti, terorganisir, memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik, serta mampu mengelola berbagai pekerjaan dengan tenggat waktu yang bersamaan.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. title: Recovery Worker
description:
Location: Head Office – Inspiration House, Unit 22, Bowburn North Industrial Estate, Bowburn, Durham, DH6 5PF. The role will involve working across seven HMP sites.

Working Hours: 37 Hours Per Week

Contract Type: Permanent

Salary: £25,877.80–£34,240

Please note: The salary listed reflects the full earning potential for this role. Starting salaries depend on experience and progression within the band.

About Waythrough

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

About the role:


An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our HMP Services as a Recovery Worker – a rewarding and impactful role where you'll support individuals experiencing challenges with drug and alcohol use across seven HMP sites.

As a Recovery Worker, you'll work with individuals at different stages of their recovery journey, from initial assessment and engagement through structured treatment and towards sustained recovery.


You'll provide person-centred support, helping individuals access appropriate interventions, develop recovery goals and build the confidence and skills needed to make positive changes.

Working across seven prison sites, you'll collaborate with prison staff, healthcare professionals, external agencies and community services to ensure individuals receive coordinated and effective support throughout their recovery journey.


In this role, you will:


  • Manage an allocated caseload, developing, implementing and reviewing individual recovery plans and treatment interventions.
  • Carry out initial screening, triage and comprehensive assessments to understand individual needs and identify appropriate support.
  • Support and motivate individuals to progress through their recovery journey, from initial engagement to sustained recovery.
  • Work collaboratively with partner agencies, colleagues and other professionals to coordinate assessments, interventions and ongoing support.
  • Complete risk assessments, safeguarding assessments and risk management plans, ensuring individuals and those around them are appropriately supported.
  • Develop and deliver tailored psychosocial interventions through both one-to-one and group-based sessions.
  • Support individuals to access treatment, community resources and peer support opportunities that promote recovery and social inclusion.
  • Help reduce drug and alcohol-related harm through harm reduction interventions, drug screening, blood-borne virus (BBV) testing, immunisation and needle exchange services.
  • Promote positive family involvement in recovery, recognising the impact substance use can have on children, parents, carers and wider family networks.
  • Maintain accurate records, contribute to service reviews and work effectively within the organisation's clinical governance and safeguarding frameworks.

About you:


You are passionate about helping people make positive changes in their lives and understand the importance of delivering compassionate, inclusive and person-centred support.


You will hold an NVQ Level 3 in Health and Social Care (or equivalent), or be willing to work towards this qualification in post.


You'll bring an understanding of evidence-based interventions, including brief interventions, Motivational Interviewing (MI), Psychosocial Interventions (PSIs), Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) and ITEP.


You'll also have experience delivering one-to-one and group-based therapeutic interventions, alongside the ability to build positive relationships and support individuals to achieve their recovery goals.


You will ideally also have:


  • Experience of working with families and carers.
  • An understanding of safeguarding, hidden harm and the impact of substance use on families.
  • Knowledge of harm reduction approaches and recovery planning.
  • Experience of carrying out assessments, recovery planning and risk management.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Office and electronic case management systems.

You will also need a full UK driving licence and access to your own car, as this role involves regular travel between seven HMP sites.


Who will you be working with?


You'll be part of a multidisciplinary team, working alongside colleagues and professionals across our seven HMP sites.


You'll collaborate with prison staff, healthcare professionals, external agencies and community partners to ensure individuals receive the right support at the right time.


Together, you'll contribute to a supportive working environment, sharing knowledge and expertise to deliver high-quality services and achieve positive outcomes for the people we support.


Our Values


At Waythrough, our values underpin everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels supported, respected and empowered.


  • Kindness
  • Courage
  • Respect

To view the Full Job Description CLICK HERE

What We Offer

We value the people who make a difference every day. Alongside meaningful work, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package:

  • 27 days’ annual leave, rising to 32 after 1 year (plus bank holidays)

  • Pension scheme with 4.5% employer contribution, matched up to 6.5%

  • Life assurance (3× annual salary)

  • Enhanced sick pay and family-friendly pay

  • Birthday leave and the option to buy up to 5 extra days’ annual leave

  • £500 Recommend a Friend bonus

  • Discounts via Blue Light Card, Charity Discounts, Extras and Tickets for Good

  • Free will writing service and wellbeing initiatives throughout the year

Inclusion and accessibility

We have signed up to the Disability Confident Scheme - all applicants are welcome, and adjustments can be made to enable fair participation.

title: Assembly & Test Operator
description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Company Overview

Teledyne is devoted to advancing science, acquiring and inventing new technology, and using it to help our customers solve challenges in business and society. Teledyne serves an immense range of applications, providing technologies vital to industrial growth markets.

What You'll Be Involved In

Teledyne Microwave UK (Lincoln) is seeking a Graduate Manufacturing Technician to join our team based at Firth Road.

This is a hands-on role working within a highly skilled and experienced team, assembling and testing technically advanced RF and electronic products used in specialist microwave radar applications.

The role involves the manufacture, test and repair of high-reliability products, alongside supporting continuous improvement activities to enhance product quality, manufacturability and production efficiency. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering high-quality output while developing their technical knowledge, practical manufacturing skills and understanding of high-reliability electronic products.

Key Responsibilities of the Role Will Include:

  • Assembly & Test - Assemble and test RF and electronic products using a range of techniques, including mechanical assembly, epoxy processes, PCB soldering and RF assembly, in line with defined build documentation. Follow detailed work instructions and test procedures to ensure consistent product quality.
