title: Vice President, Critical Engineering Manager India North - Critical Site Operations
description:
About this role


About Workplace Operations

Workplace Operations oversees the firm’s Facilities Management, Hospitality, and Critical Site Operations functions. The team includes BlackRock employees and outsourced professionals across the globe, all focused on delivering a consistent, high-quality experience for BlackRock employees and visitors.

The India Northern Region Critical Site Operations Engineering Manager supports the real estate team with site selection, critical systems design, and commissioning for offices and data centers across the India region. Because these facilities operate around the clock, the role is responsible for helping manage risk and maintain continuous uptime. This position also coordinates with design and construction, facilities management, engineering operations, and IT operations, to ensure the readiness, reliability, and integrity of mission-critical infrastructure designs throughout India. In addition, the successful candidate should be able to apply AI to strengthen and enhance BlackRock’s design standards. The successful candidate will also be a key stakeholder for the design and construction of the new India Headquarters in New Delhi.

This role requires a strong understanding of how mission critical systems operate and the ability to work closely with consulting engineers on mission-critical design. This includes knowledge of electrical switchgear, transfer switches, backup power systems, and HVAC operations. The successful candidate will also help oversee BlackRock’s IFM provider, JLL, along with other critical service providers supporting data center and facility infrastructure systems.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee the engineering design and operation of mission critical infrastructure systems and equipment across offices and data centers.
  • Manage critical systems throughout the India Northern region.
  • Lead MEP design, construction, and operational budget management.
  • Ensure compliance with BlackRock design standards, operating procedures, methods of procedure, and emergency response protocols for mission-critical environments.
  • Use AI-assisted design tools, such as generative layout engines, to develop and assess optimized HVAC, piping, and lighting layouts based on building geometry and space constraints.
  • Apply predictive AI simulations to evaluate energy use, optimize equipment sizing, and assess system performance under multiple scenarios.
  • Leverage AI-powered models to check designs against current building codes and standards, including Building Code, ASHRAE, and NEC, and identify non-compliance automatically.
  • Manage site-based MEP and IT Life Cycle Management (LCM) projects.
  • Perform ongoing assessments of infrastructure system operational readiness.
  • Review and enhance preventive and predictive maintenance procedures for all critical infrastructure systems.
  • Ensure 24/7/365 coverage and effective emergency response for infrastructure and IT equipment failures.
  • Partner with Global Critical Engineering and Global Technology teams to provide expertise on design objectives, operational performance, and infrastructure systems that support efficient and maintainable operations.
  • Provide remote technical support for India facility operations.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, facilities engineering, Data Center Operations, or other equivalent related life experience preferred.
  • Ten years of building engineering design management, facilities management, data center management, or related experience.
  • Strong knowledge of mission critical cooling systems, power systems, mechanical systems, and fire suppression systems.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven MEP plugins or generative design workflows.
  • Project management skills.
  • Knowledge of Electrical/Arc Flash Safety (NFPA 70E)
  • Electrical or HVAC licenses would be a plus.
  • Working familiarity with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Cad/BIM Platforms, and Integrated Work Maintenance Management System (IWMS) software.
  • The candidate must be available for travel, weekend work, and available for emergency problems on a 24/7/365 basis.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: 2027 Finance Apprenticeship Programme -  January 27
description:
Want to get your career off to a flying start? The sky’s the limit with TUI. We’re the world's number one tourism business, operating in around 180 destinations worldwide, which means limitless global opportunities for you and your future.

As part of our Finance Apprenticeship, you’ll spend three invaluable years working right at the heart of our business – with real responsibilities, and the chance to work on real projects. You’ll gain a unique insight into our exciting and dynamic industry, with exposure to many other functional areas and senior colleagues. You’ll have lots of fun during your time with us, and we’ll ensure you get the support you need every step of the way.

From leading our planning cycle, to pricing our holidays, recording and reporting our customer’s revenue, and making and recording the payments we make to our thousands of suppliers across the world (and much, much more!), our finance teams play a crucial role in TUI’s success.   • Work closely with the finance department to gain first-hand insight into how our dynamic business operates, including the opportunity to get involved with a variety of project work
  • Process debits and credits
  • Post journals into the finance system
  • Reconcile balance sheets
  • Produce reports
  • Analyse data and reports
  • You'll also work towards the Level 3 Assistant Accountant and Level 4 Accounting/Taxation Technician apprenticeships, as well as the AAT qualification

ABOUT YOU

  • Analytical approach to solving problems and creating solutions
  • Engages and collaborates with others
  • Natural drive to achieve both individual and business results with a commercial focus
  • Strategic thinker
  • Adapts and shows resilience if faced with adversity
  • Brings innovative ideas and insights

We welcome applications from all. However, a requirement is that you provide evidence that our grades are the correct equivalent to GCSEs/A levels or Degrees. If you have studied overseas, you may be required to apply for your grades to be converted and you can do this by visiting: Home Page (enic.org.uk) and applying for a statement of comparability.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

title: Apple TV Operations Lead - Physical Production
description:
Thrilling dramas. Epic sci-fi. Feel-good comedies. It all lives on Apple TV. With hundreds of millions of people discovering the best stories every day. We keep the creative visions of artists, writers and filmmakers intact, while sharing their works with audiences in over 100 countries worldwide.

Our Production, Strategy and Operations (PESTO) organization in Los Angeles supports productions across the globe, and as our international slate grows, so does the need for dedicated, in-region support. This role is based in London and works closely with the Head of International Production, acting as the primary point of contact for operational and technology questions for international production teams. Reporting to the Head of Post Production, VFX and Operations in Los Angeles, this role partners daily with the central PESTO team, technology, and production leadership to keep productions moving without the delays of cross-time-zone handoffs.

This role exists to close the time zone gap between our Los Angeles and London-based teams, giving international productions real-time access to operational guidance, technology support, and problem resolution during their working day. It serves as a two-way conduit — surfacing international issues to the central PESTO team for resolution, and translating central guidance, tools, and process changes into terms that work for productions. The role reduces reliance on travel, cuts down on after-hours calls, and gives both teams a consistent, dedicated partner for day-to-day operational needs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant demonstrable experience in physical production, production operations, or studio operations within film or television.
  • Proven experience supporting or managing production operations specifically in the UK or EMEA region.
  • Strong familiarity with vendor management processes across international markets.
  • Experience with resource and contingent workforce management and related compliance considerations.
  • Prior experience managing or mentoring junior production or technical staff.
  • Working knowledge of production asset management, stage logistics, and facilities operations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing operational issues and stakeholder relationships across multiple time zones or international teams.
  • Experience partnering with technology or process teams to roll out new tools or workflows to production teams.
  • Proven track record working independently to resolve ambiguous, time-sensitive operational problems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience running or supporting technology proof-of-concept programs within a production environment.
  • Knowledge of existing relationships with UK/EMEA-wide vendors.
  • Familiarity with EHS, security and/or government affairs processes as they relate to production.
  • Strong track record of building trust and alignment between geographically distributed teams.

Job Description

Job Title: Frontend Developer

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid

Job Status: Existing Vacancy

Position Summary

As a Frontend Developer on our Prediction Markets team, you will help build and maintain a secure, multi-tenant prediction-market platform designed for Latin American markets. You will primarily contribute to the mobile-first customer trading application, with opportunities to work on administrative and operational tools.

Responsibilities

Front-End Application Development

  • Design, build, test, and maintain React and Next.js web applications.
  • Develop responsive, mobile-first customer experiences using TypeScript.
  • Build reusable, accessible, and maintainable components using the platform's design system.
  • Translate business, product, and design requirements into scalable application features.
  • Build interfaces that support multilingual, multi-currency, and regional user experiences, including language, date, time, and number formatting.
  • Contribute to the design and development of secure multi-tenant and white-label platform capabilities.

Customer Experience & Trading Platform Features

  • Develop and enhance customer-facing workflows supporting market discovery, search, filtering, and category navigation.
  • Build event and market-detail experiences that present real-time pricing, order-book information, and market data.
  • Develop transaction workflows including outcome selection, bet slips, price locks, fees, order confirmation, and settlement status.
  • Create interfaces for managing open positions, working orders, transaction history, and trade activity.
  • Ensure customer-facing transaction states and financial information are displayed clearly, accurately, and consistently.
  • Deliver localized customer experiences that support multiple languages and currencies.

Administrative & Operational Solutions

  • Design and maintain administrative and operational interfaces supporting market curation and platform operations.
  • Develop finance, reconciliation, and treasury-monitoring dashboards and reporting solutions.
  • Build audit-trail views to support compliance, operational transparency, and system traceability.
  • Create internal tools that support customer service, player management, and operational support activities.

API Integration & Real-Time Services

  • Integrate frontend applications with REST and GraphQL services to deliver secure and scalable functionality.
  • Implement real-time user experiences using WebSockets to display live prices, scores, account activity, order status, and operational alerts.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to define, implement, and maintain API contracts and real-time event integrations.

Quality Assurance & Engineering Practices

  • Develop and maintain unit, component, integration, accessibility, Storybook, and end-to-end testing assets.
  • Monitor, analyze, and improve application performance, accessibility, reliability, and user experience.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, solution discussions, effort estimation, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Adhere to established software development standards for security, accessibility, testing, documentation, and code quality.
  • Collaborate with Service Desk, Technical Support, and engineering teams to troubleshoot issues and restore platform services.
  • Analyze root causes of production incidents and implement corrective and preventive measures.
  • Document production issues, resolutions, workarounds, and follow-up actions to improve operational readiness and platform reliability.
  • Support ongoing enhancements that improve system stability, supportability, and overall service performance.

Qualifications

Mandatory Qualifications

  • Legally eligible to work in Canada
  • Fluent in English (speak, read, write)
  • Able to work an on-call rotation of 1 week on/7 weeks off

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js in production environments.
  • Experience building responsive, mobile-first, and accessible user interfaces.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience developing and consuming real-time web applications using technologies such as WebSockets or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience implementing automated testing practices, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments and participating in code reviews and technical design discussions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with financial services, trading, gaming, betting, lottery, or other transaction-heavy platforms.
  • Experience building multilingual, multi-currency, or internationalized applications.
  • Experience with design systems, Storybook, and reusable component libraries.
  • Experience working with secure multi-tenant or white-label SaaS solutions.
  • Knowledge of frontend performance optimization, accessibility standards, and secure development practices.
  • Experience working in cloud-native environments and collaborating with distributed engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting production systems, participating in on-call rotations, and resolving live service incidents.

Additional Information

Our organization is committed to employment equity and diversity in the workplace. We actively encourage applications from women, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, members of visible minorities, and LGBTQ2+ individuals.

We are dedicated to removing barriers and fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects society and we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA).

title: AI/ML Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

AI/ML Data Engineer


The AI/ML Data Engineer builds and maintains the production pipelines that turn unstructured text and documents into reliable, model-ready data for our team's Generative AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications and services. Key focus areas will include engineering data products built from licensed scientific literature, patents, clinical trials, and more. You'll develop ingestion and parsing pipelines for unstructured or semi-structured text data, with data-quality checks built in. These data products support critical use cases spanning early-stage scientific research to post-market surveillance, including systematic literature reviews, competitive intelligence, target identification, and safety monitoring.


You'll be mentored by senior engineers and work directly alongside the data scientists and scientific subject matter experts who use your data. You'll gain hands-on exposure to how data feeds ML and large language model (LLM) systems, see your work accelerate research, and ultimately help bring therapeutics to patients. As you grow, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills in advanced pipeline performance tuning and lakehouse data modeling. The position is embedded within a cross-disciplinary team of data scientists, bioinformaticians, and engineers dedicated to using cutting-edge AI/ML and data science techniques to drive drug discovery and development.


What you will do:

  • Pipeline delivery: Build and maintain production data pipelines, transformations, and automated workflows that turn scientific text into data products
  • Requirements validation: Clarify the requirements for your tasks, proactively identify gaps and assumptions, and raise questions before and during implementation
  • Engineering standards: Adopt and contribute to the team's data engineering practices, propose schemas that fit the team's data standards, and actively participate in constructive code reviews
  • Data quality and reliability: Build automated schema, completeness, and constraint checks into pipelines, and create test datasets for integration and regression testing
  • Pipeline maintenance: Monitor pipelines, troubleshoot operational failures, apply dependency and platform upgrades, and keep data products reliable and cost-efficient
  • ML productionization: Support the deployment of ML pipelines into production
  • AI-assisted engineering: Use coding agents in your daily development and contribute to the team's agent-assisted workflows, such as pipeline-failure triage


What you should have

  • 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related area
  • 2+ years of experience building data pipelines using Python and SQL
  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience



What we offer:

  • Exciting work in a great team, global projects, international environment
  • Opportunity to learn and grow professionally within the company globally
  • Hybrid working model, flexible role pattern
  • Competitive salary & incentive pay
  • Pension and health insurance contributions
  • Internal reward system and referral scheme
  • 5 weeks annual leave, 5 sick days, 15 days of certified sick leave paid above statutory requirements annually, 40 paid hours annually for volunteering activities, 12 weeks of parental contribution
  • Cafeteria for tax free benefits according to your choice (meal vouchers, sport, culture, health, travel, etc.), Multisport Card
  • Vodafone, Raiffeisen Bank, Foodora, and discount programs
  • Up-to-date laptop and iPhone
  • Parking in the garage, showers, refreshments, massage chairs, library, music corner


Additional job details


In addition to building and maintaining our suite of tools, our team consults on how software capabilities, data products, and AI/ML can support the projects of our 5,000+ stakeholders (scientists, engineers, regulatory liaisons, data scientists, etc.) across our multi-national organization. We strive to enhance data science, NLP, and AI literacy across these groups.


As part of our work, our team has opportunities to coauthor internal and external presentations, white papers, manuscripts, and/or open-source code releases. We invest in your professional growth by providing access to specialized learning platforms, opportunities to attend industry conferences, participation in internal communities of practice, and the chance to learn the science of drug discovery and development directly from domain experts.

Data Engineering, Data Standards, Data Storage, Design Applications, Engineering Standards, Generative AI, Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Machine Learning (ML), Python (Programming Language), Software Development, Testing

Job Description:

You'll be responsible for overseeing the operation and maintenance of essential cybersecurity systems, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Detection Response (EDR) systems, network access control (Comply-to-Connect), and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) platforms.

HOW A CYBERSECURITY SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR WILL MAKE AN IMPACT


Responsibilities:


Configuration and Optimization:

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity stakeholders to define and implement effective configurations for SIEM, EDR, and network access control solutions.

  • Customize and optimize alert rules, correlation searches, and detection mechanisms within SIEM to align with security requirements and organizational objectives.

  • Deploy new SIEM instances including clustered deployments and apps.

  • Fine-tune EDR policies, rulesets, and scanning parameters to enhance endpoint visibility and threat detection capabilities.

  • Configure network access control policies for the comply-2-connect solution to enforce security posture and mitigate risks associated with unauthorized devices.

  • ork with other Cybersecurity Engineering team members and will be required to interact with end users to gather requirements, perform troubleshooting, and provide assistance with the creation of Splunk search queries and dashboards.

  • Integrate cyber tools with variety of legacy data sources.

  • Conduct routine maintenance tasks, such as software updates, patches, and performance tuning, to ensure the reliability and efficiency of cybersecurity systems.

  • Provide timely support and troubleshooting assistance to address issues and incidents related to SIEM, EDR, C2C, and SOAR platforms, collaborating with vendors or higher-level support as necessary.

  • Perform regular system audits and health checks to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, or performance issues, implementing corrective actions as needed.

  • Provide occasional presentations of tool capabilities to leadership

  • Policy Development and Compliance:

  • Develop and enforce configuration standards, security policies, and operational procedures for cybersecurity systems, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

  • Monitor compliance with security policies and regulations through audits, assessments, and reporting activities, taking corrective actions to address any deviations or gaps.

  • Collaborate with compliance and audit teams to streamline regulatory compliance efforts and demonstrate adherence to security standards.

  • ntegration and Automation: Integrate cybersecurity systems with other security controls, data sources, and IT infrastructure components to create a cohesive security ecosystem.

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts, playbooks, and workflows within the SOAR platform to automate routine tasks, orchestrate incident response processes, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • Explore opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging automation, orchestration, and integration with emerging technologies and industry trends.


Training and Knowledge Sharing:


  • Provide training sessions and document processes to empower internal teams with the knowledge and skills required to effectively utilize cybersecurity systems.

  • Share expertise, best practices, and lessons learned with colleagues through formal and informal channels, fostering a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing within the cybersecurity team.

title: Managing Director, Youth Development Programs
description:
Managing Director, Youth Development Programs

The Police Athletic League (PAL) of New York City is an independent youth development nonprofit organization and has been a vibrant and vital institution, serving as an effective, critical bridge between police and communities across all five boroughs of the City since 1914. PAL operates diverse programs for children as young as 2 years old to young adults. Programs include Head Start, after-school programs and summer day camps for elementary, middle and high school youth, and summer Playstreets. PAL also runs evening teen centers and college readiness programs, youth employment, and juvenile justice programs. Staying true to PAL’s roots, a cornerstone of our youth development strategy includes offering competitive and recreational sports for children of all ages. At PAL, we’re devoted to empowering communities and building the best places to work, and that goes for our own teams too.

In its 110th year, PAL continues to reimagine the agency’s leadership structure to ensure the next 110 years are nimble, strategic, responsive, and efficient. We are looking for SONYC School Program Directors to elevate our out-of-school programming embedded within a New York City public school or PAL Center. Locations may serve Elementary through High School youth through SEL, STEM, Literacy, Sports, Arts, Mental Health, and College and Career Access Programming.

This position reports to the Chief Executive Officer.

The Managing Director provides leadership, direction, and accountability to six Program Leads overseeing youth programming across five boroughs, as well as MAAP/FF and SYEP. The position ensures that programs are implemented consistently and effectively while allowing for appropriate adaptation to the needs of individual communities, funders, and program models. This position will integrate programming within PAL’s network ensuring that contractual obligations PAL has to government, private, and individual donors are met and exceeded. We are looking for Youth Development expertise and skilled talent development. This position will work closely with the NYPD, DOH, DYCD, NYCPS, and local community partners and develop new opportunities for PAL. As such, we are looking for candidates who can listen, problem solve and build bridges to partners that expand opportunities for NYC’s youth. Specifically:

  • Candidates must travel to any PAL location or PAL partner in the 5 Boroughs via car or public transportation.

  • Candidates must be well versed in Youth Development best practices.

  • Candidates must be experts in DYCD contract requirements

  • Candidates must be able to support programming that happens during the day, evenings, and weekends.

  • Candidates must be dedicated to supporting the ideas and opportunities of on-site Leaders.

  • Candidates must possess excellent communication and listening skills.

  • Candidates must work together as a team to support PAL’s programming throughout the entire City.

Major Duties & Responsibilities

1. Leads Portfolio-Wide Implementation

  • Translates agency strategy, contractual requirements, program goals, and leadership priorities into clear implementation plans and operating expectations for the Youth Development portfolio.

  • Establishes a consistent framework for program implementation across boroughs and program areas while recognizing differences in program models and community context.

  • Establishes relationships with all funders and serves as the lead liason for PAL.

  • Ensures that Program Leads understand priorities, timelines, deliverables, decision rights, and measures of success.

  • Identifies implementation barriers and works with appropriate agency leaders to resolve them quickly and effectively.

  • Monitors the overall health of the portfolio and intervenes when programs are off track.

  • Ensures that new initiatives, program changes, contracts, and organizational priorities are implemented effectively and sustained over time.

2. Directs and Develops Program Leads

  • Provides direct supervision, coaching, and accountability to six Program Leads.

  • Establishes clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and decision-making authority for Program Leads.

  • Creates a regular management cadence that includes portfolio reviews, performance monitoring, problem-solving, and planning.

  • Supports Program Leads in managing complex operational and programmatic challenges.

  • Builds the capacity of Program Leads to lead through change, manage performance, and develop strong site-level leadership.

  • Holds Program Leads accountable for implementation, program quality, compliance, staffing, participant outcomes, and contractual deliverables.

  • Creates opportunities for Program Leads to share learning, solve problems collectively, and develop consistent approaches across the portfolio.

3. Monitors Program Performance and Outcomes

  • Establishes and maintains a portfolio-level performance management system that provides leadership with a clear view of program performance aligned to funder requirements.

  • Regularly reviews enrollment, attendance, participation, staffing, program quality, outcomes, compliance, financial performance, and other key indicators.

  • Uses data to identify trends, emerging risks, underperformance, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensures that Program Leads develop and execute corrective action and improvement plans when performance falls below expectations.

  • Partners with the CEO and senior leadership team to communicate portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations.

  • Ensures that lessons learned from implementation are translated into improvements in practice, systems, and resource allocation.

4. Ensures Cross-Portfolio Alignment and Integration

  • Creates mechanisms for coordination across the four borough-based EL–HS/afterschool portfolios and the MAAP/FF and SYEP programs.

  • Identifies opportunities to share resources, systems, practices, partnerships, and expertise across programs.

  • Ensures that youth development programs operate as part of a coherent portfolio rather than as independent program silos.

  • Works with the Head Start Managing Director to identify opportunities for alignment between Head Start and Youth Development programming where appropriate.

  • Coordinates with agency-wide operational departments to ensure that program needs are understood and addressed.

5. Partners Across the Senior Leadership Team

  • The Managing Director partners closely with the CEO, COO, CFO, CAO, and other senior leaders to identify barriers to implementation, align resources, manage risk, and drive continuous improvement across the Youth Development portfolio.

  • Serves as the primary Youth Development partner to the CEO on implementation, performance, and portfolio management.

  • Partners with the COO to address operational systems, staffing structures, facilities, technology, and other infrastructure necessary for successful program delivery.

  • Partners with the CFO to monitor budgets, expenditures, revenue, contract performance, and financial risks across the portfolio.

  • Partners with the CAO on grant requests, funder reports, and events.

  • Ensures that cross-functional issues are escalated appropriately and resolved in a timely manner.

  • Brings a Youth Development perspective to agency-wide planning and decision-making.

6. Oversees Change and Continuous Improvement

  • Leads implementation of significant changes affecting the Youth Development portfolio, including new contracts, funding changes, program models, organizational structures, and agency initiatives.

  • Develops implementation roadmaps, milestones, ownership structures, and communication plans for major changes.

  • Anticipates the impact of change on staff, programs, participants, and operations.

  • Ensures that Program Leads are equipped to lead change at the borough and program level.

  • Establishes mechanisms for evaluating whether changes have been successfully implemented and sustained.

  • Promotes a culture of learning, reflection, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

7. Manages Risk, Compliance, and Accountability

  • Maintains visibility into major programmatic, operational, staffing, financial, contractual, and reputational risks across the portfolio.

  • Ensures that Program Leads identify and proactively manage risks within their areas of responsibility.

  • Partners with appropriate agency departments and funders to address compliance concerns and contractual requirements.

  • Ensures timely escalation of significant issues to the CEO and other members of the senior leadership team.

  • Supports the development and monitoring of corrective action plans when necessary.

8. Supports Strategic Planning and Growth

  • Provides the CEO with analysis and recommendations regarding the future direction of the Youth Development portfolio.

  • Assesses program capacity, organizational readiness, resource requirements, and implementation implications of new opportunities.

  • Participates in strategic planning, annual planning, budgeting, and organizational priority-setting.

  • Helps evaluate potential new programs, contracts, partnerships, and funding opportunities from an implementation and organizational-capacity perspective.

  • Ensures that growth is matched by appropriate staffing, infrastructure, systems, and leadership capacity.

9. Management Cadence and Accountability

The Managing Director establishes a predictable management cadence that creates visibility, accountability, and rapid problem-solving across the portfolio. This includes:

  • Weekly or biweekly meetings with Program Leads focused on priorities, barriers, and decisions.

  • Regular portfolio performance reviews using a shared dashboard or scorecard.

  • Monthly review of financial and contractual performance in partnership with Finance.

  • Bi-annual portfolio reviews with the CEO and senior leadership.

  • Regular review of staffing, vacancies, compliance, program quality, and emerging risks.

  • Annual portfolio planning and goal-setting.

  • Structured after-action reviews and learning processes following major initiatives or periods of implementation.

Key Measures of Success

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

  • Youth Development programs consistently meeting or exceeding contractual and organizational expectations.

  • Strong performance across enrollment, participation, attendance, quality, and youth outcomes.

  • Program Leads demonstrating strong leadership, accountability, and problem-solving capacity.

  • Clear visibility into portfolio performance, risks, and resource needs.

  • Timely identification and resolution of implementation barriers.

  • Consistent implementation of agency priorities across boroughs and programs.

  • Effective management of major organizational and programmatic changes.

  • Strong cross-functional partnership between Youth Development and agency support departments.

  • A culture of accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

  • Sustainable growth and effective stewardship of the Youth Development portfolio.

As a Production Engineering Auxiliary, your role is to support the day-to-day operation and maintenance of auxiliary test heads and related production equipment. description:
Rol: Senior Systems Integration Architect

Location: Matosinhos, Porto, Portugal

Type of contract: permanent


Carrier is the leading worldwide provider of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, fire, security, and cold chain solutions. We invented the modern air conditioning, and our team of pioneers and innovators have a long history of developing new technologies.


Addvolt, now part of Carrier, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, delivers advanced electrification technology, integrated power management and power electronics capabilities for transport refrigeration and auxiliary systems. Driving innovation in the electrification and decarbonization of onboard systems for refrigerated trailers, trucks, vans and containers, Addvolt empowers fleets to avoid fuel usage, reduce major emissions and operate efficiently at a remarkably low noise level. By combining Addvolt’s innovative power solutions with Carrier Transicold’s expertise in transport refrigeration, we are enhancing the value we deliver to fleets, original equipment manufacturers and logistics operators worldwide. Together with Carrier, we are accelerating the transition to a more sustainable, efficient and intelligent cold chain.

Job description summary

The Senior systems integration architect – Aftermarket connected solutions leads the system-level architecture, interface governance, and multi-tier integration for aftermarket enhancements, connected retrofit kits, and digital telematics solutions across Truck and Trailer refrigeration platforms.

Situated directly within the Embedded systems engineering organization and centered on the Aftermarket engineering solutions portfolio, this role serves a high-impact dual mandate:

  • Aftermarket integration leadership: Architecting how embedded refrigeration controllers seamlessly connect outward to telematics units, aftermarket sensors, auxiliary power solutions, cloud ecosystems, and mobile fleet management applications.
  • Systems engineering catalyst: Championing a holistic systems engineering mindset across the embedded team, translating commercial aftermarket opportunities into robust system boundaries, interface contracts, and modular software/hardware architectures.

Role focus & operating model

To maximize cross-functional velocity and ensure long-term architectural stability, this role operates under a clear, system-level charter:

  • Strategic architectural scope: The position is dedicated to high-level system design, interface control, feasibility evaluation, and multi-tier integration. It partners closely with component-level firmware developers who handle low-level device drivers, board bring-up, and routine sprint bug maintenance.
  • Interface governance authority: Serves as the designated technical authority for authoring, reviewing, and approving Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and data communication contracts connecting embedded platforms to aftermarket peripherals and digital backends.
  • Collaborative systems coaching: Acts as an internal mentor within embedded systems, facilitating architecture design reviews and fostering systems-thinking methodologies (requirements decomposition, V-model traceability, and boundary modeling).

Key responsibilities

1. Aftermarket architecture & multi-tier integration

  • Lead the end-to-end technical system architecture for aftermarket products, telematics upgrades, and retrofit kits across transport refrigeration units.
  • Define and govern interface boundaries between embedded refrigeration controllers, telematics gateways, cloud data brokers, mobile applications, and customer interfaces.
  • Author, maintain, and baseline formal Interface Control Documents (ICDs), messaging schemas (CAN/J1939, Modbus, MQTT, REST, Protobuf), and API contracts.
  • Evaluate technical feasibility, system trade-offs, power-management constraints, and integration risks for new aftermarket feature requests and customer-specific retrofit programs.

2. Systems engineering catalyst & mentorship

  • Drive the adoption of structured systems engineering practices within the embedded systems team, ensuring firmware enhancements are developed with total machine behavior and vehicle network topologies in mind.
  • Decompose customer, aftermarket commercial, and regulatory requirements into clear, testable, and traceable subsystem functional specifications.
  • Establish and facilitate regular architectural review rhythms, guiding firmware and hardware engineers on state-machine modeling, modular design, and robust failure-mode handling.
  • Promote early defect detection by ensuring system-level requirements are unambiguous and verifiable prior to sprint implementation.

3. Cross-functional collaboration & technical leadership

  • Serve as the embedded systems team’s primary technical liaison to aftermarket product managers, application engineering, product testing, field service, and external electronics suppliers.
  • Partner with product managers to translate commercial aftermarket business cases into realistic technical architectures and execution roadmaps.
  • Collaborate closely with dedicated program managers, offloading administrative schedule and budget tracking to focus squarely on technical alignment and interface integrity.
  • Coordinate with product testing engineering to ensure aftermarket system requirements are covered by automated verification environments (SIL/HIL).

4. Supplier engagement & technical documentation

  • Lead technical discussions with third-party electronics suppliers, sensor manufacturers, and telematics hardware partners to adapt proven commercial solutions to Carrier equipment.
  • Support supplier evaluation, technical requirement specifications, and Request for Information (RFI) reviews.
  • Own and maintain system-level architecture diagrams, interface registers, and requirements baselines using enterprise project documentation and ticketing platforms.
  • Ensure all aftermarket connectivity and controller integrations comply with corporate cybersecurity guidelines, data encryption protocols, and safety standards.

Typical product & technical domains

  • Aftermarket solutions: Connected retrofit packages, auxiliary power management upgrades, specialized temperature monitoring kits, fuel-saving controls, and peripheral sensor retrofits.
  • Embedded control systems: Microcontroller architectures (ARM Cortex, STM32 platforms), real-time operating systems (FreeRTOS), and hardware abstraction layers.
  • Vehicle & industrial networks: CAN 2.0B / CAN FD, SAE J1939, RS-485, and proprietary controller area networks.
  • Connected ecosystems: Cellular/telematics gateways, cloud messaging pipelines (MQTT/JSON), remote monitoring, over-the-air (OTA) update frameworks, and fleet management APIs.

Tools & platforms

  • Architecture & systems modeling: UML/SysML modeling platforms, block diagrams, and system topology tools.
  • Project documentation & tracking: Enterprise requirements traceability platforms, technical wikis, and issue/defect tracking tools.
  • Embedded network analysis: CAN diagnostic tools (Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, PCAN), oscilloscopes, serial analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
  • Version control & integration: Git repository workflows and automated build/integration environments.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, systems engineering, mechatronics, or related technical field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive professional experience in systems engineering, embedded systems design, or connected IoT product development.
  • Strong knowledge of embedded hardware, microcontrollers, and vehicle communication protocols (CAN/J1939).
  • Demonstrated track record of authoring Interface Control Documents (ICDs), system requirements, and architectural specifications.
  • Proven ability to coordinate technically across multiple engineering domains (hardware, firmware, cloud, and test).
  • Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills with an appetite for mentoring peers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master’s degree in systems engineering, electrical engineering, or software engineering.
  • Direct experience in commercial transportation refrigeration, heavy vehicles, automotive systems, or industrial machinery.
  • Experience delivering aftermarket retrofit solutions, sensor integration packages, or connected vehicle telematics.
  • Familiarity with secure embedded architectures (secure boot, cryptographic authentication, and secure OTA firmware distribution).
  • Experience partnering with commercial product managers to evaluate supplier electronics and third-party modules.


Success measures & key performance indicators

  • First-pass integration quality: High success rate and minimal rework during integration trials between embedded controllers, telematics gateways, and aftermarket retrofit kits.
  • Interface stability: Delivery of complete, unambiguous ICDs and API contracts with zero breaking changes during downstream execution.
  • Systems mindset elevation: Observable adoption of requirements traceability, architectural reviews, and modular design practices across the embedded engineering team.
  • Aftermarket delivery predictability: Reliable delivery of technical architectures supporting planned aftermarket launch milestones.
  • Documentation rigor: Up-to-date, comprehensive system architecture documentation maintained across all active aftermarket projects.

title: Regional Agronomy Manager, Northern Region
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Regional Agronomy Manager to join the team on a permanent, full-time basis. This is a significant leadership opportunity within Elders’ agronomy business.


Reporting to the Chief Agronomist, the Regional Agronomy Manager drives the performance and growth of agronomy across the Northern Region. You will play a key role in building the regional agronomy structure and capability, including establishing and developing Agronomy Area Manager capability across the region. You will translate strategy into action, building capability, market share and commercial growth, while ensuring our agronomy advice, products and services deliver genuine value for customers.


What you'll be responsible for

  • Lead the regional agronomy business, translating Elders' national agronomy strategy into clear regional priorities, plans, KPIs and actions.
  • Manage and develop Agronomy Area Managers and their teams, setting expectations, building capability and supporting performance and succession.
  • Drive profitable growth and market share, identifying opportunities to grow agronomy products, professional services and customer relationships.
  • Keep the customer at the centre, ensuring our advice, products and services solve real agronomic challenges and deliver genuine value.
  • Build the capability and depth of our agronomy team through coaching, succession planning, recruitment, training and career development.
  • Monitor performance through KPIs, dashboards and business data, identifying opportunities and addressing performance gaps.
  • Partner with Retail, Marketing and regional leaders to turn agronomic opportunities into sustainable commercial outcomes.
  • Provide senior technical leadership and maintain high standards of agronomic advice, professional practice and customer service.
  • Lead regional agronomic risk, governance and quality assurance, including significant crop complaints and technical incidents.
  • Support the adoption of new agronomic technologies, products and services where they create clear customer and commercial value.

About you


We are looking for someone who combines strong agronomic credibility with demonstrated people and commercial leadership.


You will bring:

  • Significant experience in agronomy, agricultural sales, technical advisory or a related agricultural field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing people, including setting expectations, coaching, performance management and developing capability.
  • A track record of delivering commercial growth, increased market share or improved business performance.
  • The ability to turn strategy into action and hold teams accountable for delivery.
  • Strong commercial understanding of agronomy products, professional services, pricing, margin and customer value.
  • The ability to use business data and performance measures to identify opportunities and improve results.
  • Strong technical credibility and sound judgement around agronomic risk and quality.
  • The confidence to lead across a large, geographically dispersed business and build strong relationships with regional and enterprise stakeholders.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Agriculture, Agronomy or a related discipline, or significant relevant industry experience.
  • A full, unencumbered driver's licence.
  • Experience operating at a regional or national level within an agricultural or sales organisation will be highly regarded.

Why this role?


This is an opportunity to help shape the future of agronomy within Elders. You will work collaboratively with our teams to build capability, grow market share and strengthen business performance, while supporting our people to deliver even greater value to customers. For someone looking to broaden their impact across people, strategy and commercial outcomes, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference.


About Elders


As a trusted Australian agribusiness, we have played an important role in the agricultural sector for 185 years. Our expansive network across Australia offers links to markets, tailored advice and specialist knowledge across a range of products and services, including farm supplies, agronomy, livestock, wool, grain, finance, insurance, and real estate.


We are committed to a sustainable and prosperous future for rural and regional communities and creating value for all stakeholders in the agricultural supply chain, across both Australian and international markets.


Elders is for Australian agriculture.


We are now looking for the next generation to be part of something big and drive the future of Elders.

title: Physical Therapy Technician - Per Diem
description:
Who we are:

Spire Orthopedic Partners is a growing national partnership of orthopedic practices that provides the support, capital and operational resources physicians need to grow thriving practices for the future. As a Management Services Organization (MSO), Spire provides the infrastructure for administrative operations that allows practices to operate at their highest level, so doctors can focus their efforts on what matters most – patient care. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, the Spire network spans the Northeast with more than 165 physicians, 1,800 employees, 285 other clinical providers and 40 locations in New York, Connecticut, Rhode Island and Massachusetts.

What you’ll do:

Responsibilities/Duties:

  • Clean and organize work area and disinfect equipment after treatment.

  • Prepare and maintain a safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations.

  • Observe patients during treatment to compile and evaluate data on patients' responses and progress, and report to physical therapist.

  • Instruct, motivate, safeguard, and assist patients practicing exercises and functional activities, under direction of medical staff.

  • Confer with physical therapy staff and others to discuss and evaluate patient information for planning, modifying, and coordinating treatment.

  • Transport patients to and from treatment areas, using wheelchairs or providing standing support.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

11

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery

  • Partner with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target enterprise data platform.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance for enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational reliability, and secure AWS deployment patterns.
  • Implement and promote repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support across onboarded datasets.
  • Ensure pipelines are designed and operated in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of maintenance.
  • Support the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines using AWS services such as:
    • Amazon S3 for durable data lake storage
    • AWS Glue for data integration, cataloging, and processing
    • AWS Lambda for event-driven processing
    • Amazon Kinesis for streaming use cases
    • AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls
    • AWS IAM for secure access control
  • Promote the use of encryption, environment-level controls, access policies, and platform guardrails to support secure access to platform resources and data products.
  • Apply lakehouse technologies and concepts such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Databricks Unity Catalog, metadata-driven pipelines, and governed data access patterns.

AI-Assisted Engineering and Context Engineering

  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude, GitHub CoPilot, LLMs, and similar platforms to accelerate data engineering delivery while maintaining enterprise quality and security standards.
  • Apply AI tooling to support common engineering activities, including:
    • Code generation
    • Code refactoring
    • SQL and PySpark optimization
    • Unit test generation
    • Documentation creation
    • Pipeline analysis
    • Troubleshooting and debugging
    • Data quality rule suggestions
    • Runbook and operational support documentation
  • Apply prompt engineering and context engineering practices to improve the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Structure technical context for AI-assisted work, including requirements, schemas, data contracts, architecture constraints, coding standards, logs, error messages, acceptance criteria, and governance requirements.
  • Create or contribute to reusable prompt templates, context packs, and engineering playbooks for common data platform activities such as Databricks migration, AWS data engineering, pipeline troubleshooting, and test generation.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated code, recommendations, documentation, and analysis before applying them to production-grade engineering work.
  • Ensure responsible use of AI tooling by following enterprise standards for security, privacy, sensitive data protection, compliance, and human review.

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement

  • Support asset-agnostic data onboarding patterns that can accommodate a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case.
  • Work with platform, data engineering, architecture, governance, and business-aligned teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the enterprise platform.
  • Help offshore and global teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed, consistency, and reduce friction.
  • Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch, streaming, and event-driven use cases.
  • Create or contribute to reusable technical assets such as:
    • Design patterns
    • Reference implementations
    • Onboarding templates
    • Pipeline frameworks
    • Technical documentation
    • Operational runbooks
    • AI-assisted engineering templates
  • Support metadata-driven and configuration-driven pipeline patterns to improve scalability, consistency, and maintainability.

Data Mastering Platform Integration

  • Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
  • Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows.
  • Help implement data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows required to support trusted mastered data in the platform.
  • Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion, enrichment, and distribution workflows.
  • Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including:
    • Data acquisition
    • Cleansing
    • Enrichment
    • Mastering
    • Reconciliation
    • Golden copy generation
    • Downstream distribution of trusted data products
  • Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, market data, investment data, risk data, and related mastered domains.

Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence

  • Serve as a senior technical individual contributor for data platform engineering, with hands-on involvement across pipeline migration, lakehouse architecture, AWS-native data engineering, governance, AI-assisted engineering, and mastering integrations.
  • Provide technical guidance to engineers, delivery partners, and platform stakeholders without direct people management responsibility.
  • Contribute to architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, implementation planning, technical standards, and production readiness reviews.
  • Translate architectural direction into practical engineering tasks, implementation patterns, and reusable technical assets.
  • Promote engineering best practices including:
    • Version control
    • Automated testing
    • CI/CD
    • Infrastructure as code
    • Release automation
    • Monitoring and alerting
    • Incident response
    • Documentation
    • Production support readiness
  • Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure automation, release management, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks.
  • Drive operational discipline across production data pipelines, including observability, logging, telemetry, support models, service ownership, and incident management.

Collaboration, Governance, and Platform Standards

  • Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, security, Databricks-aligned, and data mastering teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards.
  • Act as a technical bridge between platform direction and engineering execution.
  • Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around:
    • Data lineage
    • Schema consistency
    • Data quality
    • Metadata
    • Retention
    • Access control
    • Encryption
    • Auditability
    • Secure data distribution
  • Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, telemetry, dashboards, and AWS-native operational tooling where appropriate.
  • Help improve consistency and reusability across data onboarding and pipeline delivery by contributing to platform guardrails, standards, engineering playbooks, and reusable implementation patterns.

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience

  • 6–8+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, cloud data architecture, software engineering, or related engineering domains.
  • Demonstrated experience operating as a senior individual contributor, technical lead, senior data engineer, lead data platform engineer, or equivalent technical role.
  • Proven ability to support technical initiatives and influence engineering outcomes in a complex, execution-focused environment.
  • Experience partnering with global or distributed teams to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and improve delivery quality without direct people management authority.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows.
  • Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture.
  • Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as:
    • Amazon S3
    • AWS Glue
    • AWS Lambda
    • AWS Lake Formation
    • Amazon Kinesis
    • AWS IAM
    • AWS-native monitoring, logging, and security capabilities
  • Working knowledge of technologies and concepts such as:
    • Delta Lake
    • Apache Iceberg
    • Databricks Unity Catalog
    • Metadata-driven pipelines
    • Data lake governance
    • Lakehouse architecture
    • Catalog-driven processing
  • Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, risk data, or trusted data distribution workflows.
  • Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, encryption, and operational support for production data pipelines.
  • Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, policy-based access controls, and secure platform operations.
  • Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release management, and monitoring.
  • Experience implementing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, telemetry, dashboards, and production support procedures.

AI Tooling and LLM-Enabled Engineering

  • Practical experience using AI tooling such as Claude, GitHub CoPilot, LLMs, or similar AI-assisted development platforms in an engineering context.
  • Experience applying LLMs to data engineering or software engineering workflows, including code generation, refactoring, test creation, documentation, debugging, troubleshooting, and pipeline analysis.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and context engineering, including how to structure technical context, examples, constraints, schemas, logs, coding standards, and acceptance criteria to improve AI-generated outputs.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted workflows to support Databricks development, AWS data engineering, SQL, PySpark, pipeline migration, data quality analysis, and operational support activities.
  • Ability to evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated code or recommendations before applying them to production-grade engineering work.
  • Understanding of responsible AI usage in enterprise environments, including security, privacy, compliance, human review, and protection of sensitive or regulated information.

Collaboration and Execution

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams.
  • Ability to translate architectural direction into actionable technical deliverables, implementation plans, and reusable engineering patterns.
  • Comfortable operating in a role that blends hands-on engineering, technical guidance, and delivery enablement.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate ambiguity in complex enterprise data platform environments.
  • Ability to partner with engineers, architects, governance stakeholders, and business-aligned data teams to drive practical outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise data onboarding frameworks across multiple business domains, asset classes, or source system types.
  • Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging, metadata management, business glossaries, lineage, operational metadata platforms, or semantic data layers.
  • Knowledge of semantic modeling is a plus, particularly for supporting consistent business definitions, governed data consumption, data discoverability, and alignment between business terminology and technical data products.
  • Exposure to semantic layers, canonical data models, domain models, metrics layers, business glossaries, ontologies, or knowledge graph concepts is a plus.
  • Exposure to data mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, corporate actions, risk data, or golden record workflows in financial services environments.
  • Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets.
  • Experience with NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, stewardship, golden copy creation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
  • Experience applying AI-assisted engineering practices to data pipeline migration, Databricks development, AWS data engineering, metadata analysis, data quality investigation, documentation automation, or production support.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, enterprise knowledge bases, or LLM-enabled documentation/search patterns is a plus.
  • Experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments where data governance, data controls, auditability, lineage, privacy, and security requirements are important.
  • Databricks certifications, AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus.

title: Recovery Care Specialist Full Time Float (35458)
description:
Full Time Recovery Care Specialist- Float 1st & 2nd shift RCS (average 32 hours weekly)

Position Summary
Recovery Care Specialists (RCS) interact with clients throughout the shift, assists and supports clients with functionally needs. Recovery Care Specialists are responsible for managing the daily milieu of the facility, ensuring the safety of clients, and maintaining a therapeutic environment. RCSs are expected to familiarize themselves with the histories and needs of the clients and be capable of identifying cues and behaviors that may indicate a change in clients’ status or condition. Position is responsible for documenting in the client records and communicating proactively with clinical team members and supervisor(s).

Relationships and Contacts
Within the organization: Maintains frequent and close working relationships with program staff and facility team members throughout the organization.

Outside the organization: Initiates and maintains strong professional relationships with clients and families, clinical providers, referral partners and vendors, as needed.

Position Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities
1. Collaborates with clinical team to determine/select appropriate interventions based on the needs of individual clients.
2. Actively participates and engages clients in the milieu and outside activities throughout the workday, often in a variety of group settings.
3. Encourages clients to perform ADLs, which include tasks like cleaning their room, maintaining hygiene, and doing laundry, to include conducting client drug screening, pregnancy tests, and breathalyzer tests as needed.
4. Prompts clients to attend all meals in a timely manner and provides supervision and structure at mealtimes as appropriate.
5. Models effective table manners and small talk during mealtimes, focusing on engaging all clients.
6. Provides, structures, and maintains a therapeutic environment in collaboration with other staff.
7. Therapeutically interacts with the client in one-to-one situations, community, and group meetings, maintaining appropriate boundaries and modeling appropriate social behavior.
8. Collaborates with clinical team to facilitate client education groups.
9. Reacts therapeutically in crisis situations.
10. Recognizes client’s level of behavioral functioning and modifies approaches accordingly to include recognizing mood changes and developing DBT coping skills.
11. Maintains therapeutic relationship with clients using praise and other reinforcers to encourage appropriate behaviors and attitudes, setting limits in a kind and firm manner.
12. Documents, in accordance with policies and procedures, services provided, incident reports, shift reports, and group/milieu notes in a timely and accurate manner.
13. Complies with the facility safety procedures as outlined in the policy and procedure manual to include fire drills, evacuation procedures, and internal/external disaster plan.
14. Demonstrates effective verbal intervention skills in managing escalating clients and involving other staff as needed adhering to DBT model and interventions.
15. Performs a vehicle safety and fuel check prior to use of any company vehicle, reporting any concerns to supervisor or manager.
16. Supports clients in effectively managing leisure time, including joining in activities with clients.

title: Data & Signal Analysis Scientist - Q
description:

At Sony UK Technology Centre, the Surface Mount (SMT) Department plays a key role in producing high-quality circuit boards for both Sony-branded products, such as our broadcast cameras, and third-party products, including the Raspberry Pi single-board computer.Our team strives to deliver innovative products and processes, with quality at the forefront of everything we do.


The SMT Engineering Manager role plays a key part in the SMT Department, leading a team of Engineers and Technicians. The role of the team is to maximise our machine availability and performance, while maintaining the highest quality levels. Key tasks to support this include TPM (Maintenance), structured approach to machine breakdowns, and regular monitoring of process data to drive improvement actions.


The role of the SMT Engineering Manager is to lead and support the team, who work in shift patterns to provide full coverage of the SMT Production lines. A critical part of the role is developing the team’s skills and capabilities, supporting each team member to fulfil their potential and contribute to the team’s success through training, mentoring and practical experience.

As a member of the SMT Operations Team, the SMT Engineering Manager will work closely with Production Managers, Quality Managers and NMI (New Model Introduction) Managers.

  • Manage spare parts inventory, ensuring optimal stock levels, availability of critical components and effective cost control.
  • Monitor and control departmental budgets, including maintenance costs, scrap and resource utilisation.
  • Drive engineering activities focused on product and process quality, working closely with the SMT Quality Manager to resolve issues and prevent recurrence.
  • Lead and facilitate structured problem-solving activities, applying DMAIC methodologies to identify root causes, implement corrective actions and deliver sustainable improvements.
  • Prepare, maintain and communicate clear, accurate technical reports, providing relevant performance data, analysis and recommendations to support informed decision-making.
