title: Experienced Workday Integration Developer
description:
What makes us, us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp! At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

Why this role is important to us

We are looking for an experienced Workday Integration Developer to help maintain and enhance our Workday platform. In SimCorp, we use a broad set of Workday modules across HCM and Finance. Based in Warsaw or Copenhagen, you will be part of the Group IT ERP team. The team comprises 12 colleagues with various roles, including a Functional Specialists, Integration Specialists and Business Analysts. You will report to the Head of ERP, based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

As a Workday Integration Developer, you will play a key role in evolving and optimizing our Workday platform across multiple functional areas. Your responsibilities will span:

  • Integration Support & Development: Maintain, enhance, and build new integrations to and from Workday using Core Connector, EIB Outbound, Workday Studio (inbound and outbound) and Boomerang, ensuring seamless data flow and operational efficiency. Support the adoption of newer Workday integration technologies, such as Workday Orchestrate.
  • Feature Configuration: Configure and deploy AI-driven features and user interface enhancements across Workday modules to improve user experience and automation.
  • AI Adoption & Continuous Learning: Drive AI adoption across the team, be willing to learn how to build AI agents using Claude, and develop new skills such as Workday Extend.
  • Release Management: Participate in bi-yearly Workday releases, ensuring smooth adoption of new functionalities and system updates.
  • Support & Lifecycle Ownership: Provide third-level support and manage the full development lifecycle—from requirement gathering and solution design to implementation and production deployment.

This involves using Workday to standardize, simplify, centralize, and automate processes and ensure efficient operational processes around the Workday application. The work environment is dynamic and rapidly growing within an international company with significant growth potential and career opportunities. If you seek to contribute to the organization’s success and develop professionally, consider working with us.

Your working hours will align with the EMEA time zone. It is expected that you will be present in our Warsaw or Copenhagen office for two days a week.

What you will be responsible for

  • Support, enhance, and develop Workday integrations using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and Workday Studio—while ensuring stability and scalability.
  • Manage system roles, security domains, and business process policies to maintain a secure and well-governed Workday environment.
  • Execute tasks related to internal and external audit requests, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
  • Configure AI-driven features and user interface enhancements across Workday modules to improve usability and automation.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (P&C, Finance, IT) and external vendors to gather requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Maintain clear documentation of configurations, integration designs, and support procedures to ensure transparency and continuity.
  • Participate in Workday release cycles by assessing the impact of new features and ensuring smooth adoption across the platform.
  • Contribute to our innovation process by proposing new ideas and implementing backlog items, change requests, and enhancements that optimize platform performance.
  • Adhere to IT principles and proactively suggest future changes that align with strategic goals.

What we value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing to and thriving in the role described above. How you acquired your skills is less important - we value your potential, mindset, and willingness to learn. We expect you to bring strength in several of the areas below and to be motivated to develop further in others.

  • Experience in HR technology, HRIS, automation, digital transformation, or process improvement.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, and Web Services (SOAP/REST)
  • Strong understanding of XML, XSLT, JSON, and REST/SOAP APIs
  • Familiarity with Workday security domains, role configurations, and business process policies, with the ability to implement changes aligned with governance standards.
  • Experience executing tasks related to internal and external audit requests, ensuring compliance and traceability.
  • Exposure to configuring AI-driven features, user interface enhancements, and contributing to platform optimization through innovation initiatives.
  • Preferably Workday Pro certified
  • Familiarity with Workday HCM, Financials, or other modules is a plus
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in English, bridging IT and business stakeholders
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, to ensure deadlines are achieved
  • Working knowledge of Agile (Kanban) methodologies is considered an advantage
  • You have a sense of humor

Benefits

SimCorp offers several benefits that might play a significant factor in considering whether to accept a job offer. Since SimCorp operates in 30+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

SimCorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

For Poland location:

Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement. Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

Next steps

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who we are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer.

We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

  • CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please login to Workday to complete the internal application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please login to Workday to complete the student application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete the application process for external applicants.

Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

This position is funded for 12 months; continuation past 12 months will be based on university need, performance, and/or availability of funding.

​

POSITION SPECIFICS​

The Concepts, Imagery, and Simulation in Cognition Lab, headed by Dr. Emiko Muraki, is seeking a full-time Human Research Technologist.

The Human Research Technologist will have the opportunity to work on studies investigating how the mind grounds and simulates concept meaning, bridging perception, action, imagery, and language in adults.


In doing so, the lab incorporates several techniques, including EEG, fMRI, behavioral research methods, and quantitative statistical analysis.

This work will take advantage of the University’s broad resources, including the Center for Language Science and the Social, Life, and Engineering Sciences and Imaging (SLEIC) Center.

Important Note: This position requires a flexible schedule to include working some evenings and weekends, primarily to accommodate the availability of research participants.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Recruit and schedule study participants, manage recruitment platform signups, and maintain participant records
  • Assist with behavioral, EEG, and fMRI study design, programming, and data collection
  • Process, clean, and analyze behavioral and/or neural data using quantitative statistical analysis
  • Prepare and maintain study materials, data, and analysis code for sharing on open science repositories
  • Support the training and coordination of undergraduate research assistants; may assist in the interviewing, training, and scheduling of these students
  • Coordinate the day-to-day activities in the lab, such as coordinating with the Institutional Review Board and documenting lab procedures and protocols

MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS

Associate Degree
No prior relevant work experience required; previous relevant work experience accepted in lieu of education.
Required Certifications:
None

Preferred Qualifications (one or more):

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Neuroscience, or a related field
  • Experience in a lab that conducts behavioral or neuroimaging studies
  • Experience with EEG or fMRI
  • Research experience with Python, R, or Matlab

Important Application Instructions:

Applicants must upload a cover letter of interest, highlighting relevant skills, and a CV/resume.

Additional Information:

Questions regarding the position may be addressed to Dr. Emiko Muraki at ejmuraki@psu.edu

The Department of Psychology in the College of the Liberal Arts at Penn State is home to the Concepts, Imagery, and Simulation in Cognition Lab.

The College of the Liberal Arts is supportive of flexible work arrangements when aligned with the ability to meet the needs of the unit and the essential duties of the position. Questions related to flexible work should be directed to the hiring manager during the interview process.

BACKGROUND CHECKS/CLEARANCES

Employment with the University will require successful completion of background check(s) in accordance with University policies.

Penn State does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of a staff employment Visa. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

SALARY & BENEFITS

The salary range for this position, including all possible grades, is $33,504.00 - $48,552.00.

Salary Structure - Information on Penn State's salary structure

Penn State provides a competitive benefits package for full-time employees designed to support both personal and professional well-being. In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, employees enjoy robust retirement plans and substantial paid time off which includes holidays, vacation and sick time. One of the standout benefits is the generous 75% tuition discount, available to employees as well as eligible spouses and children. For more detailed information, please visit our Benefits Page.

This role picks up exactly there: chasing the right materials, keeping suppliers honest on lead times, and getting the job rebooked and back on track, all while keeping the customer confident that it is being handled. If you like following something through until it is properly closed out, this is a satisfying role to be in. You will be working on behalf of a long standing Australian client in the glass repair and replacement industry, supporting their Incomplete Planning function. At Acquire Intelligence, we invest in our people and build careers, not just fill roles. Your work will directly protect the client's time to service promise on every job that needs a second visit.


Role Snapshot

The Incomplete Planner is responsible for delivering on the time to service promise for jobs not completed on the first visit, ordering the correct glass and materials, coordinating outside services, and working with suppliers to confirm accurate lead times so jobs can be rebooked efficiently. The role also keeps customers updated on job status and pricing, and confirms deposits or approvals before work proceeds. Coverage is a confirmed day shift of 8:00am–5:00pm AEST (Sydney/Melbourne time, adjusting automatically with Australian daylight saving).


Key Responsibilities

Material & Resource Management

• Track and coordinate the ordering, delivery, and storage of glass and materials.

• Work with suppliers to avoid delays in material procurement.

• Respond promptly to quality issues and take corrective action. Customer Service

• Deliver a professional, caring, and friendly experience by phone and in writing.

• Keep customers informed of schedule changes, delays, or conflicts.

• Ensure jobs are executed in line with customer expectations. Productivity & Supplier Relationship Management

• Ensure accuracy of orders, including products, quantities, and specifications, so lead times can be confirmed for rebooking.

• Communicate proactively with planners and glazing supervisors on orders, delays, and issues to keep project timelines on track.

• Participate in supplier service review meetings covering performance, lead times, and pricing.


Qualifications & Experience Essential

• Excellent attention to detail, identifying missing information and outstanding actions.

• Persistence, following jobs through to completion.

• Strong organisation skills, managing a large volume of incomplete work at once.

• Sound time management, prioritising ageing and high risk jobs.

• Comfortable following up with branches, suppliers, and customers by phone as well as in writing.

• Process discipline, following established procedures consistently.

• Confident navigating multiple systems.

• Clear communication skills, maintaining accurate notes and comprehension both internally and externally.

• Strong problem solving, escalating or resolving issues appropriately.

• A sense of accountability and ownership of outcomes.


Desirable

• Experience with job management software such as SimPro.

• Previous experience in project coordination, ideally within the glazing industry.


What we value:

We are proud of our diverse global team, all working in a collaborative environment and guided by these shared values:

Curious and Clever: Smart questions spark smart solutions.

Entrepreneurial Energy: Think like an owner. Solve like a founder.

Fast with Intent: We move fast and deliver real results.

Laugh and Learn: We don’t take ourselves too seriously, just our results

Good-to-Have Skills

title: ME ES FARM PULLET MAGETAN CPD
description:
PT Ciomas Adisatwa mencari kandidat yang berdedikasi dan berkualifikasi untuk posisi ME ES Farm Pullet Magetan CPD (Maintenance Engineer / Engineering Specialist - Farm Pullet Magetan Commercial Poultry Division).

Berlokasi di fasilitas peternakan kami di Magetan, peran ini bertanggung jawab untuk mengawasi, memelihara, dan mengoptimalkan seluruh sistem mekanikal, elektrikal, dan struktural di peternakan ayam dara (pullet). Kandidat yang terpilih akan memastikan efisiensi operasional yang maksimal, meminimalkan waktu henti (downtime), serta mendukung standar biosekuriti dan kesejahteraan hewan melalui pemeliharaan teknis yang prima.


Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan:

1. Melakukan pemeliharaan preventif dan korektif secara rutin terhadap seluruh mesin peternakan, instalasi listrik, sistem pengatur iklim (climate control), serta peralatan pemberian pakan dan minum otomatis dan manual.

2. Melakukan identifikasi masalah (troubleshooting) dan perbaikan atas kerusakan mekanikal maupun elektrikal dengan cepat guna meminimalkan gangguan pada operasional peternakan.

3. Memantau dan memelihara sistem daya cadangan (generator) serta sistem penyediaan air untuk memastikan layanan utilitas peternakan tetap berjalan tanpa gangguan.

4. Mengawasi dan mengoordinasikan pekerjaan teknis, serta memastikan seluruh aktivitas teknik mematuhi ketentuan ketat PT Ciomas Adisatwa terkait biosekuriti, keselamatan kerja (K3), dan regulasi lingkungan.

5. Mengelola inventaris suku cadang, peralatan kerja, dan perlengkapan teknis, serta menyusun laporan pemeliharaan secara berkala untuk Manajer Peternakan (Farm Manager) dan divisi teknik regional.


Kualifikasi Pekerjaan:

1. Minimal lulusan Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Mekatronika, atau disiplin ilmu teknis terkait.

2. Memiliki pengalaman dalam bidang pemeliharaan teknis (maintenance engineering), diutamakan di lingkungan peternakan unggas modern (sistem kandang tertutup/closed-house), industri manufaktur, atau sektor pertanian.

3. Memiliki pengetahuan yang kuat mengenai PLC, instalasi kelistrikan, sistem otomatisasi, generator, dan sistem perpipaan (plumbing).

4. Bersedia ditempatkan di lokasi peternakan di Magetan dan mematuhi protokol biosekuriti peternakan yang ketat, termasuk bersedia tinggal di lokasi (on-site) jika diperlukan.

5. Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik, serta mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun kolaboratif dalam lingkungan peternakan yang dinamis.

​

POSITION SPECIFICS​

The School of International Affairs (SIA) is seeking an Assistant Director of Admissions to support graduate student recruitment, admissions operations, prospective student engagement, and the School’s customer relationship management (CRM) system.


SIA is a professional graduate school offering a Master of International Affairs (MIA), Master of Science in Global Economic and Business Relations (GEBR), graduate certificates, Integrated Undergraduate-Graduate (IUG) opportunities, and joint degree programs. The Assistant Director will contribute across the graduate enrollment cycle, from initial outreach through application, admission, and enrollment.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

  • Serve as a primary point of contact and user for the School’s CRM system (Slate), supporting day-to-day admissions CRM operations including queries, reports, forms, communications, events, portals, and related processes.
  • Develop, maintain, and analyze admissions and recruitment reports and data to support enrollment planning, outreach strategies, and decision-making.
  • Build and execute targeted email communications and campaigns in Slate for prospects, applicants, admitted students, and other audiences throughout the enrollment cycle.
  • Support graduate recruitment through developing social media ad campaigns, digital marketing, and online outreach efforts, helping to increase program visibility and attract prospective students.
  • Meet with and counsel prospective students regarding SIA programs, admissions requirements, the application process, and the graduate student experience.
  • Respond to admissions inquiries in a timely, professional, and student-centered manner throughout the recruitment and admissions cycle.
  • Review graduate admissions applications and make recommendations on applicant files in accordance with established School and University guidelines.
  • Coordinate and participate in virtual and in-person information sessions, webinars, workshops, recruitment programs, and admitted-student/yield events.
  • Support prospect and inquiry data management, including importing and maintaining recruitment lists and helping ensure CRM data accuracy and integrity.
  • Collaborate with School leadership and colleagues in marketing, academic advising, student services, and other University offices to support recruitment and enrollment goals.
  • Track recruitment and admissions activity and help assess the effectiveness of outreach campaigns, events, and enrollment strategies.
  • Occasionally travel to graduate recruitment fairs, conferences, and other admissions-related events on behalf of the School.
  • Assist with other admissions and enrollment initiatives as needed throughout the recruitment cycle.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in admissions, enrollment management, student services, higher education, recruitment, or a related field.
  • Experience with CRM or enrollment management systems; experience with Technolutions Slate is strongly preferred.
  • Strong comfort working with data, reports, systems, and technology, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills, and outstanding written and oral communication skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
  • A proactive, self-directed work style and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Experience with recruitment communications, outreach/admissions marketing, email campaigns, or social media is a plus.
  • Experience recruiting graduate and/or international students is a plus.

MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree
3+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience accepted
Required Certifications:
None

WORK ARRANGEMENTS:

This is a hybrid position with the flexibility to work up to 1-2 days per week remote, consistent with School and University policies and operational needs. This position requires operation of a motor vehicle as part of the job duties. A valid driver's license and successful completion of a motor vehicle records check will be required in addition to standard background checks.

BACKGROUND CHECKS/CLEARANCES

ABOUT UNITED ACTIVITIES UNLIMITED:
Staten Island, NY; United Activities Unlimited, Inc. (UAU) is a community-based agency that provides a wide range of services that is inclusive from job placement, youth development programs and community outreach services to inspire, transform, and empower individuals of all ages. UAU is responsive to the needs of diverse populations and implements programs that support positive outcomes for individuals and communities. The comprehensive nature of UAU's programming options and the emphasis on holistic services for individuals and families make UAU an outstanding resource and a pillar of support for communities. UAU is dedicated to the engagement, education, and empowerment of individuals and strives to transform individuals and communities to create a better future. EOE

POSITION SUMMARY:
The Assistant Director of Workforce Development is a member of the Workforce Development Department’s leadership team responsible for overseeing a diverse portfolio of workforce development and education programs. The Assistant Director provides direct supervision, coaching, and support to assigned Program Directors and will be responsible for ensuring programs operate effectively, meet contractual requirements, achieve established performance goals, and provide high-quality services to participants. The Assistant Director’s portfolio includes Train & Earn, Learn & Earn, CRED, BOOST, FutureReady, as well as additional programs or initiatives assigned based on departmental needs. Working under the direct supervision of the Deputy Director of Workforce Development, and in collaboration with the Director of Workforce Development, the Assistant Director serves as the primary management-level point of accountability for the assigned program portfolio. This position requires an experienced program leader capable of supervising multiple programs with different populations, funders, performance requirements, and service models, while maintaining consistent expectations for quality, accountability, and results. The Assistant Director of Workforce Development is responsible for complying with all standards established by UAU and reflecting the organization’s core values of honesty, respect, and responsibility.


PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES (include but are not limited to):
• Provide direct supervision, coaching, guidance, and performance management to assigned Program Directors and other designated staff.
• Oversee the operations and performance of Train & Earn, Learn & Earn, CRED, BOOST, FutureReady, and other programs or special initiatives assigned to the portfolio.
• Establish clear expectations for Program Directors and hold program leadership accountable for achieving contractual, programmatic, staffing, and organizational goals.
• Conduct regular individual supervision meetings with Program Directors to review program performance, staffing, participant services, contract deliverables, operational challenges, and upcoming priorities.
• Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of the requirements, performance measures, budgets, reporting expectations, and data systems associated with each assigned program.
• Monitor key program performance indicators, including enrollment, participation, retention, completion, credential attainment, employment outcomes, educational outcomes, and other contract-specific deliverables, as applicable.
• Identify programs or performance areas that are not meeting expectations and work with Program Directors, the Deputy Director, and the Director of Workforce Development to develop and implement corrective strategies.
• Review program data and reports for accuracy, completeness, trends, and areas requiring additional management attention.
• Ensure Program Directors develop and maintain effective program plans, staffing structures, participant workflows, supervisory practices, and systems for tracking progress toward established goals.
• Support Program Directors in developing their leadership and supervisory skills, addressing staff performance concerns, strengthening team operations, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
• Coordinate with the Deputy Director regarding vacancies, staffing needs, employee performance concerns, corrective action, and other personnel matters.
• Recommend hires for assigned programs in coordination with the Deputy Director and Human Resources.
• Monitor program spending in partnership with Program Directors, the Deputy Director, and Finance, and identify potential spending concerns, operational needs, or budget variances.
• Review programmatic purchasing and resource requests within established departmental and organizational procedures and escalate requests requiring additional approval.
• Maintain strong professional relationships with program funders, government agencies, schools, community partners, training providers, employers, worksites, and other stakeholders associated with assigned programs.
• Ensure Program Directors respond appropriately and timely to funder requests, corrective actions, performance concerns, and compliance issues.
• Support the planning and launch of new programs, contracts, sites, or initiatives assigned to the Workforce Development Department.
• Coordinate activities and resources across assigned programs when collaboration is necessary to achieve departmental goals.
• Assist with the development of program models, scopes of work, staffing structures, budgets, implementation plans, and other materials related to new funding opportunities.
• Participate in regular Workforce Development leadership meetings and provide concise updates regarding program performance, emerging risks, staffing, contractual requirements, and management priorities.
• Immediately elevate significant concerns involving participant safety, personnel matters, funder relationships, contractual performance, fiscal risk, or organizational reputation to the Deputy Director and/or Director of Workforce Development, as appropriate.
• Mediate and assist in resolving escalated issues involving employees, participants, parents, schools, employers, partners, and other stakeholders.
• Ensure continuity of supervision and program operations during Program Director vacancies or absences by developing temporary coverage arrangements with department leadership.
• Visit program sites regularly to observe program operations, engage with staff and participants, assess implementation, and ensure alignment with organizational and contractual expectations.
• Perform other related duties as necessary or assigned.

title: Independent Finance and Investment  Committee Member
description:
Independent Finance and Investment Committee Member

Please note, this is a remote role but the applicant is required to reside in the UK.


Interview date 10th December via Teams


About Waythrough

Waythrough provides specialist support across mental health, alcohol, drugs and related areas. We delivery high-quality, evidence-based services designed around the real needs of the people we serve.


Every year, we support around 125,000 people through over 250 services - and it's all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.



About the role

Make a meaningful contribution to Waythrough's future by joining our Finance and Investment Committee as an Independent Committee Member.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced finance or investment professional to use their expertise to support the financial sustainability and long-term success of a national charity. Working alongside Trustees and senior leaders, you will bring an independent perspective, specialist knowledge and constructive challenge to discussions around finance, investments and risk.


You will play an important advisory role in strengthening financial oversight, supporting informed decision-making and ensuring Waythrough's resources are managed effectively to support our mission of helping people overcome challenges and build better lives.


This is an advisory position rather than a Trustee role, meaning you can make a valuable contribution without holding the legal responsibilities associated with being a Charity Trustee.


The commitment involves four Committee meetings per year, each lasting approximately two hours, alongside preparation and occasional advice between meetings.


Key duties

  • Provide independent specialist advice and professional insight on financial, investment and treasury matters.
  • Contribute to discussions around investment strategy, fund management, treasury management and financial performance.
  • Review and scrutinise complex financial information, offering constructive challenge and supporting effective decision-making.
  • Help the Committee assess financial risks, assurance arrangements and opportunities for improvement.
  • Share relevant professional expertise, sector knowledge and best practice to strengthen the Committee's effectiveness.
  • Support the Committee Chair in ensuring discussions remain focused on the Committee's purpose and responsibilities.
  • Attend quarterly Committee meetings, reviewing relevant papers in advance and contributing actively to discussions.
  • Provide advice between meetings where appropriate on matters within the Committee's remit.
  • Maintain independence, confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries, declaring and managing any potential conflicts of interest.

About you


We are looking for an experienced finance or investment professional who can bring specialist knowledge, independent thinking and constructive challenge to support Waythrough's long-term financial sustainability.


You will have:

  • Significant senior-level experience in finance, treasury management, investment management or a related discipline.
  • Experience of investment strategy, fund management, treasury management or asset oversight.
  • The ability to interpret and analyse complex financial information and communicate your insights clearly.
  • Confidence to provide objective, constructive challenge and contribute to high-level discussions.
  • A strong understanding of good governance and the responsible management of organisational resources.
  • A genuine interest in Waythrough's work and the importance of lived experience in shaping and improving services.
  • The ability to work collaboratively with Trustees, senior leaders and fellow Committee members.

It would also be beneficial if you have previous experience serving on boards, committees or advisory groups, alongside knowledge of charity finance, regulatory compliance and risk management.


Above all, you will share Waythrough's values of being honest, kind and courageous, and be passionate about using your professional expertise to make a positive difference to people's lives.


For Full Information Please Click Here

What We Offer

We value the people who make a difference every day. Alongside meaningful work, you’ll enjoy:

  • Discounts from various schemes

  • Training and personal development

  • A chance to make a real difference in people’s lives

  • Free induction and role-specific training

  • Support from experienced staff and regular supervision

  • Opportunities to meet new people and develop your confidence

  • Reimbursement for travel and agreed expenses

  • Valuable experience that can support your personal or career development

Inclusion and accessibility

Waythrough is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities, especially those with lived experience of the issues we support.

We have signed up to the Disability Confident Scheme - all applicants are welcome, and adjustments can be made to enable fair participation.

If you need adjustments or support to apply, please email our recruitment team: recruitmentteam@waythrough.org.uk

How to apply

If you’re viewing this advert on an external platform such as Indeed, please click ‘Apply via company website’ to view the full job description and submit your application.

Please note that while this role has a stated closing date, we reserve the right to close the advert early should we receive a high number of applications.

title: Lead Engineer (System Development)
description:
Job Title: Lead Engineer (System Development)

Location: Glasgow, ScottishPower HQ

Salary + benefits: From £63,200 to £79,000 + benefits



Help us create a better future, quicker


As a Lead Engineer (System Development) in our Transmission Network team, you will represent SP Transmission (SPT) in the national system planning processes that shape Great Britain's energy future. You will shape our input to the Centralised Strategic Network Plan (CSNP) and the Strategic Spatial Energy Plan (SSEP). You will also establish the internal processes that keep SPEN fully engaged and well represented in these external processes.

Your work will help us identify, develop and assess future projects in good time, so we can deliver our role in the UK's drive to reach Net Zero by 2050. You will work with colleagues across SPEN, the National Energy System Operator (NESO), other Transmission Owners and Ofgem. You will also help develop engineering proposals for submission to Ofgem, making sure they are accurate, clear and compliant with regulation.



What you'll be doing


You will develop and implement internal policies and processes, in line with best practice, so that SPEN engages effectively with GB planning processes and meets its legal and licence requirements.


You will work closely with the Network Planning, Strategic Investment, Regulation and Major Projects teams. In partnership with these teams, you will turn the outputs of the CSNP, SSEP and related planning processes into deliverable investment plans. You will act as SPEN's point of contact for strategic engagement and coordination across these whole-system planning processes, and you will bring commercial and technical innovation into our policies and plans to maximise value while managing risk.


You will also:


  • Join industry working groups and joint projects with partners across the sector
  • Prepare, review and help deliver industry and licence documentation, including the SSEP, CSNP and Business Plans
  • Produce and coordinate detailed engineering proposals for Ofgem, with clear evidence, modelling and engineering rationale
  • Make sure every proposal meets our internal governance standards
  • Maintain thorough documentation and audit trails for regulatory submissions
  • Coordinate input from colleagues at all levels of the business, meeting licence deadlines and regulatory timescales
  • Raise awareness of SPEN's position on wider network planning among key industry groups and stakeholders
  • Put safety, quality and environmental excellence at the centre of everything you do
  • This role has no direct reports. You will achieve results through influence, working with senior colleagues across SPEN and the wider industry.



What you'll bring


You will hold a degree and have significant experience in transmission network planning, development, operation or regulatory strategy. This includes applying NETS SQSS and Grid Code requirements. You will have a firm grasp of GB network design standards and codes, and of how the transmission network operates.


You will also have:


  • Working knowledge of System Operator Transmission Owner Code (STC) processes and procedures at the NESO interface, including those that feed into the wider system planning documents
  • Expert knowledge and significant experience of the regulatory, technical and commercial frameworks that affect SPEN
  • Experience of setting and implementing strategies, policies and plans
  • Experience of regulatory submissions and/or price controls
  • Working knowledge of the electrical characteristics of power system equipment, such as transmission overhead lines, cables, and shunt and series reactive compensation
  • Working knowledge of advanced data processing and evidence-based methods, legal and licence obligations, industry codes and standards, and financial policies and procedures
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Experience of managing and influencing internal and external stakeholders at a senior level
  • Strong planning and organisation skills, and the flexibility to adjust priorities as business needs change
  • A track record of excellent customer service
  • Awareness of SPEN, ScottishPower and Iberdrola strategic aims, and of international developments in power system design
  • You should be willing to travel occasionally for site visits, workshops or stakeholder meetings. This is not mandatory.



What's in it for you


As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action -- our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world -- today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:


  • 36 days annual leave
  • Holiday Purchase - perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
  • Equity Plans
  • Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
  • Technology Vouchers - save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
  • Electric Vehicle Schemes - to help you transition to green/clean driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
  • Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
  • Life Assurance (4x salary)
  • Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
  • Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more



Why SP Energy Networks


SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make up the transmission network, linking infrastructure like wind farms to the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's goal to be Net Zero by 2044. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing >£5.5 billion into our transmission network, directly enabling the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a focus on investing in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.


Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Alongside our values, they make us a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.


We aim to provide reasonable adjustments and assistance in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related help. If you need assistance, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com.


Mobility

title: Platform Engineer - NL Based
description:
Your new company

We are New10, a financial service scale-up initiated by ABN AMRO Bank. At New10 we believe that business financing should be easy and accessible. Our purpose is to empower businesses to access the funding they need. Though our mission is simple, our ambition is bold: become the #1 engine powering North-West European SMEs.

To support our growth towards this ambition, we’re looking for a Platform Engineer.

Your new role

You'll join the Platform team, a small group of engineers who own the foundations that help every product team at New10 ship faster, more securely and at lower cost. We own the foundational layers for AWS, CI/CD, Developer Tooling and Observability. In this role you'll focus on developer experience. You'll make the everyday work of our engineers smoother: faster feedback loops, fewer manual steps, and, as your own initiative, a golden path from idea to production. Engineers will be your customers.

We work with a lot of autonomy. You'll get real ownership from day one, and teammates will help you sharpen your ideas and grow your scope over time. In practice, that means:

  • Own our golden path initiative: define how a new service at New10 should be built and shipped, turn our internal standards (CI/CD, observability, security) into templates teams actually want to use, and measure adoption to keep improving the path
  • Build and improve internal developer tooling, such as CLIs, templates, service scaffolding and automation, that speeds up work across engineering
  • Improve our CI/CD pipelines so builds are faster, more reliable and easier to understand
  • Evaluate new tools, run small experiments, and help engineering teams adopt what works
  • Write clear documentation so teams can help themselves
  • Contribute to our AWS and infrastructure foundations as the tooling needs it

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who has…

  • 3+ years of experience in a platform, DevOps, or software engineering role with a strong interest in developer productivity
  • Solid coding skills in TypeScript, Python and/or Go. You build tools, not just glue scripts

Interested?

title: QA Team Lead, Customer Experience
location: Argentina; Colombia; Mexico; Brazil; Chile; Peru
description:
About Us

HarZa Group builds and scales direct-to-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our team has taken e-commerce brands from zero to seven and nine figures, we grew 12x in a single year, and we now run close to 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote-first by design, async-first by default, and high-accountability by standard. The one constant across every role is overlap with our 8am to 12pm EST collaboration window.

The Role

We are hiring a QA Team Lead to own the quality standard for Customer Experience across both of our brands, and to lead the people who enforce it.

This is not a monitoring seat and it is not an individual contributor seat with a better title. Today quality is measured, but the scores are not trusted by leadership, the rubric does not separate a good interaction from a compliant one, and coverage depends on whether recordings and data happen to be in place. You are coming in to rebuild the standard from the ground up, prove that it reflects reality, and then run a small team of evaluators against it.

Your job is to make the quality number something the business can make decisions on. That means a rubric leadership agrees with, calibration that holds between evaluators, coverage across phone, email and chat on both brands, and a feedback loop that turns what you hear in interactions into fixes, not just into agent coaching.

What You Will Own

Standards. You define what quality means at HarZa, in writing, agreed with the Head of CX and the CX leadership team. You rebuild the scoring rubric so that it weighs accuracy, policy compliance, retention behavior and resolution completeness, not just tone, and so that a high score on your rubric correlates with a customer who stayed. You own the rubric's maintenance as products, offers and policies change.

The team. You lead the evaluators doing the day-to-day auditing: you set their coverage quotas, you run calibration sessions so that two evaluators score the same interaction the same way, you review their work, and you develop them. You are accountable for their output and their accuracy, not just your own.

Coverage and integrity of the data. You are responsible for knowing that what should be audited is auditable: recordings exist, conversations are captured, sample sizes are representative by brand, channel and agent. Gaps in the data are your problem to surface and close, not an excuse for a missing month.

Coaching and escalation. You turn findings into targeted coaching plans with the team leads rather than into reports nobody reads. Critical violations, including incorrect refunds, unauthorized offers and compliance exposure, go up immediately with the evidence attached. You support evaluation of new hires through their ramp window.

Feedback into the business. You run a recurring read on what the interactions are actually telling us: where customers are confused about price or offer structure, which scripts are failing, which policies are unclear, which product or funnel problems are showing up as support volume. You bring those with a recommendation, not as a list of problems.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Four or more years in quality assurance, CX compliance or CS supervision, with at least two of them leading other people, whether as a QA lead, a supervisor or a team lead. We need evidence you have managed evaluators or agents, not only audited them.

Evidence that you have built or rebuilt a QA rubric from scratch, not only applied one you inherited, and that you got leadership to agree it was right.

Hands-on experience evaluating both voice and written interactions. Phone call auditing is a hard requirement, not a nice to have.

Direct-to-consumer or e-commerce background, ideally with subscriptions, recurring billing, refunds and retention conversations in scope. Health and wellness experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Hands-on familiarity with a helpdesk platform and a telephony platform at configuration level, not agent level. Our stack includes Richpanel, Checkout Champ, AirCall, ClickUp and Slack.

Analytical strength: you can spot a pattern across qualitative data, quantify it, and defend it when a founder challenges the number.

Written English strong enough that your feedback is clear, specific and immediately actionable to agents across more than 15 countries.

The decision-making standard we hold everyone to: you do not escalate questions. High-impact, hard-to-reverse decisions come up with the problem stated, the root cause, at least three options, your recommendation and your reasoning. Everything else you decide close to the problem and communicate.

Benefits

What We Offer

A fully remote, international contractor position with real ownership over the quality standard of a fast-scaling CX operation, and direct access to CX and company leadership.

Wellness stipend.

Performance bonus structure.

Paid time off.

Sick leave.

Parental leave.

title: Senior Full Stack AI/ML Engineer
description:
Job Description

Senior Full Stack AI/ML Engineer


The Senior Full Stack AI/ML Engineer designs, builds, and scales the user interfaces, APIs, and backend services that power our team's Generative AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications. Key focus areas will include engineering applications and APIs that enable users to search data, interact with AI outputs, and extract actionable insights. You'll also design and build reusable packages and component libraries to share across our broader team. These applications support critical use cases spanning early-stage scientific research to post-market surveillance, including systematic literature reviews, competitive intelligence, target identification, and safety monitoring.


You'll work directly alongside the data scientists and scientific subject matter experts who use your applications. You will have the autonomy to propose architectural directions, see your work streamline complex workflows, and ultimately help bring therapeutics to patients. As you grow, you'll have opportunities to expand into emerging areas, such as optimizing our APIs for large language model (LLM) tool calling and building connectors that integrate them into enterprise AI platforms. The position is embedded within a cross-disciplinary team of data scientists, bioinformaticians, and engineers dedicated to using cutting-edge AI/ML and data science techniques to drive drug discovery and development.


What you will do:

  • End-to-end delivery: Deliver features hands-on from user interface to backend logic with integrated data and AI capabilities, and drive development of complex initiatives
  • Requirements validation: Partner closely with stakeholders to clarify requirements and critically examine them for assumptions, feasibility, consistency, and completeness throughout the design lifecycle
  • Application standards: Shape modern application-layer patterns for UIs, APIs, and business logic across the team
  • Solution design: Write technical specifications that weigh architectural options, trade-offs, and risks, recommending the best-fit tools and approaches
  • Application quality: Ensure interfaces are accessible (compliant with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, WCAG) and performant, and APIs are secure and observable, all backed by unit, integration, and component tests
  • Application ownership: Own, maintain, and support the team's production applications, proactively driving upgrades, bug resolution, and technical debt reduction
  • AI-enabled development: Integrate coding agents into team workflows, such as automated code review and fixes, test generation, and dependency upgrades, with appropriate human oversight
  • Knowledge building: Mentor team members through design discussions and constructive code reviews, and translate technical knowledge into clear, comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials


What you should have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on full-stack or frontend-heavy application development
  • 3+ years of experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-grade applications using React and TypeScript
  • Experience designing and building robust REST APIs in at least one backend language, combined with a working familiarity with Python



What we offer:

  • Exciting work in a great team, global projects, international environment
  • Opportunity to learn and grow professionally within the company globally
  • Hybrid working model, flexible role pattern
  • Competitive salary & incentive pay
  • Pension and health insurance contributions
  • Internal reward system and referral scheme
  • 5 weeks annual leave, 5 sick days, 15 days of certified sick leave paid above statutory requirements annually, 40 paid hours annually for volunteering activities, 12 weeks of parental contribution
  • Cafeteria for tax free benefits according to your choice (meal vouchers, sport, culture, health, travel, etc.), Multisport Card
  • Vodafone, Raiffeisen Bank, Foodora, and discount programs
  • Up-to-date laptop and iPhone
  • Parking in the garage, showers, refreshments, massage chairs, library, music corner

Additional job details

In addition to building and maintaining our suite of tools, our team consults on how software capabilities, data products, and AI/ML can support the projects of our 5,000+ stakeholders (scientists, engineers, regulatory liaisons, data scientists, etc.) across our multi-national organization. We strive to enhance data science, NLP, and AI literacy across these groups.


As part of our work, our team has opportunities to coauthor internal and external presentations, white papers, manuscripts, and/or open-source code releases. We invest in your professional growth by providing access to specialized learning platforms, opportunities to attend industry conferences, participation in internal communities of practice, and the chance to learn the science of drug discovery and development directly from domain experts.

title: Senior Director – Amgen’s Clinical Vaults
description:
Career Category

Clinical Development

Job Description

JOIN AMGEN’S MISSION OF SERVING PATIENTS


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas, Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease, we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Senior Director – Amgen’s Clinical Vaults

What you will do:

In this vital role as Senior Director, Amgen’s Clinical Vaults, you will be responsible for advancing the modernization and transformation of clinical operations across Amgen’s global development portfolio.

This leader will drive strategic innovation and implementation through adoption of emerging technologies, AI-enabled capabilities, process digitization and optimization initiatives in our CTMS, EDC and DQS ecosystems that improve quality, speed, efficiency, and scalability of clinical trial execution.

This role serves as the transformation and business product lead for the GDO’s Strategic Business Plan which includes D2 (Differentiated Delivery), ACT FAST and TWFS transformation initiative. The Senior Director, Amgen X Vault Platform is accountable for defining and executing Amgen's strategy for the Veeva Clinical ecosystem, encompassing CTMS, EDC, and DQS including the transitionary period between legacy EDC.

This leader will drive the convergence of digital protocols, connected clinical operations, integrated data review, and cross-vault collaboration to accelerate study startup, improve trial quality, and establish an industry-leading, data-driven clinical development platform. Working in close partnership with Veeva, AI&D, DTI, Clinical Development, GDO, RBQM, and Regulatory teams, this role will shape the future operating model of clinical trial execution leading to cycle time reduction.


Strategic Leadership

· Own the cross clinical vaults strategy: Define and execute Amgen's R&D and GDO strategy for clinical vaults, positioning CTMS, EDC and DQS as integrated, standard-driven platforms that enable consistent clinical execution and reusable data assets.

· Lead Strategic Partnership with Veeva: Serve as Amgen's executive relationship owner for the Veeva clinical ecosystem, influencing product direction, co-innovating future capabilities, shaping roadmap priorities, and ensuring Amgen remains at the forefront of platform adoption and innovation.

· Be part in defining the strategy for business functions: Be the embedded part of Study Start-Up, Study Operations and Data Management to be part of defining the functional strategy under Strategic Business Plan of GDO

· Define Seamless Clinical Data Flow: Establish an integrated digital data flow from protocol to study planning and design through study execution, acquisition, data review enabling a seamless analysis and regulatory submission readiness.

  • External Technology Landscape Leadership: Continuously assess emerging technology trends, competitive practices, regulatory developments, and innovation opportunities across the CTMS, EDC and DQS technology ecosystem; translate insights into strategic recommendations that position Amgen as a digital leader in clinical development.

Execution and Delivery of Strategic Business Plan

  • Be accountable for executing on the strategy and plan: Be accountable for delivery of all strategic business plan elements fully integrated with the platform strategy of CTMS, EDC and DQS roadmap

· In close Collaboration with AI&D: Partner with AI&D, IT and business stakeholders to develop and deploy AI-enabled workflow, automation and intelligence capabilities that improve quality, speed, consistency and reuse.

  • Continuous Improvements: Champion continuous improvement and transformation initiatives that simplify operations, standardize processes, and strengthen organizational effectiveness.
  • Audit Ready Clinical Vaults: Ensure transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate quality, compliance, and regulatory considerations and is always audit ready through cross-functional partnership and governance.

Functional Management

  • Build and lead a high-performing organization focused on execution and delivery of the GDO Strategic Business Plan and associated enterprise transformation commitments.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a global team while fostering a culture of accountability, agility, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop organizational capabilities, operating models, and skillsets required to support evolving business, technology, and portfolio needs.
  • Partner closely with GDO leadership and enterprise stakeholders to align transformation priorities, resource needs, and execution plans.

External Representation and internal stakeholder partnerships

  • Collaborate across the external life sciences landscape, Tech and SaaS providers, AI&D, DTI and GDO functions to ensure strategic initiatives, transformation activities, and operational priorities remain aligned and effectively executed.
  • Support evaluation and integration activities related to new technologies, external partnerships, and organizational transformation opportunities, including M&A activities as applicable.
  • Maintain external awareness of industry trends, competitive capabilities, and innovation opportunities that may enhance operational quality, efficiency, speed, and scalability.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

· Master’s with 15+ years of clinical data landscape transformation execution experience OR

· Bachelor’s with 18+ years of clinical data landscape transformation execution experience AND

· 5 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources


Preferred Qualifications:

· 15+ years of experience in clinical development, clinical operations, operational excellence, business transformation, program management, or related functions within the biopharmaceutical industry.

· Demonstrated success leading large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives, including tech transformation, process modernization, organizational change management, and business capability development.

· Experience implementing and scaling AI-enabled solutions, automation technologies, advanced analytics, and digital capabilities within clinical development or other regulated environments.

· Proven ability to establish and lead as a business product owner supporting complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives and program execution.

· Should have lead at least 1 major transformation/Migration of CTMS, EDC and CDR/DQS

· Technical Knowledge: Experience with AI, digital health and informatics tools that may advance ways of working within the clinical trial ecosystem.

Core Competencies:

· Enterprise cross-functional leadership across clinical data landscape with deep functional process expertise.

· Deep understanding of clinical operations technologies, AI-enabled capabilities, automation, digital platforms, and enterprise data strategy.

· Expertise leading large-scale transformation initiatives, of process and foundational technologies for Global Development Operations

· Experience driving process, data, and technology transformation, digital enablement, and organizational change management within highly matrixed environments.

· Strategic thinking with the ability to advance business performance through innovation, technology transformation and adoption, and modernization of clinical operations capabilities.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

.

title: North Texas Area Manager
location: E.Q.U.I.P. Enterprises Inc - San Antonio, TX 78249
description:
Area Manager — North Texas E.Q.U.I.P. Enterprises

Are you the kind of leader who takes full ownership of an operation — the people, the budgets, the customer relationships, the results? You don't need to be micromanaged? You need a mission worth your effort and the authority to execute it?

E.Q.U.I.P. Enterprises is looking for an Area Manager to oversee a portfolio of federal and state government contracts across multiple sites throughout North Texas. You'll be on the road each week — visiting your sites, leading your teams, and ensuring every location runs the way it should. We provide the vehicle and gas card. You bring the leadership.

The Mission

E.Q.U.I.P. Enterprises is a social enterprise that provides facility management services through the WorksWonders programs. We exist to create meaningful employment, job skills training, and real career pathways for disabled veterans and people with disabilities.

This isn't a tagline. It's the reason we operate. The Area Manager role is where mission meets execution — and we need someone who takes both seriously.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Reporting to the Director of Operations, you will have direct accountability for:

Operations & Contract Performance You own the full scope of work across your assigned contracts — deliverables, timelines, quality standards, and compliance. You'll conduct regular site visits throughout North Texas, perform quality inspections, and ensure every location meets or exceeds contract specifications. When problems arise, you make the call and resolve them.

People Leadership You'll lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of Project Managers, Supervisors, Crew Leads, and frontline personnel. This means coaching, mentoring, training, managing employee relations, and making the difficult personnel decisions when needed. You set the standard your people rise to.

Financial Stewardship You manage P&L for your portfolio. You operate within budget, practice disciplined supply management, conduct daily, weekly, and monthly fiscal audits, and take corrective action when you identify negative trends. You don't wait to be told there's a problem — you find it first.

Customer Relationships You are the primary point of contact for your customers. You build trust through consistent, reliable service delivery. You increase service standards, resolve escalations, and ensure your customers know they're in capable hands.

Growth You identify opportunities to expand within your territory and work to grow revenue across your locations. You think like an owner, not just an operator.

Reporting & Communication You deliver clear, accurate daily, weekly, and quarterly reports that give senior leadership full visibility into how your operation is performing — operationally and financially.

Safety & Compliance You champion occupational safety across every site and serve as an awareness ambassador for Safety and Loss Prevention. You protect the organization's assets and resources through proactive cost control and sound decision-making

Job Summary:

Under the direction of the Director of Operations, the Area Manager serves as a trainer, mentor, and operational leader for multiple government contracts under the AbilityOne and WorksWonders programs. This role focuses on developing people—coaching Supervisors, Crew Leads, and field teams to grow in skill, confidence, and impact. The Area Manager ensures contract goals are met by building capable teams, modeling high standards, and nurturing a mission-driven culture. They operate within budget, maintain accountability of equipment, and cultivate strong relationships with customers and employees alike. At the heart of this role is a deep commitment to empowering individuals with disabilities through meaningful employment and consistent leadership.

.Job Duties:

  • Operate as the lead point of contact for any and all matters specific to customers and employees.
  • Understand the full scope of each contract to include deliverables and manage all contract functions.
  • Manage the project in a cost-efficient and effective manner.
  • Actively mentor and train assigned Supervisors and field staff—focusing on building leadership capacity, upholding standards, and promoting personal growth.
  • Manages employee relations issues.
  • Provide clear, consistent updates to leadership, focused not only on operational metrics but also on team development progress and site-level improvements.
  • Create a learning environment across contract sites by identifying teachable moments, providing field-based training, and modeling leadership that empowers rather than controls.
  • Perform random quality inspections to ensure superior service delivery, reduce customer complaints, and identify opportunities for employee development.
  • Identify growth opportunities within the territory and work to increase sales targets for individual locations.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships.
  • Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our services according to customer needs and objectives.
  • Assist with high severity requests or issue escalations as needed
  • Guides teams through performance expectations with a coaching mindset—providing real-time feedback, hands-on support, and growth plans tailored to each leader.
  • Responds to emergent field-level issues with sound judgment, ensuring timely resolution while protecting both staff well-being and contract integrity.
  • Maintains an active presence at contract sites to ensure alignment between field operations, employee engagement, and corporate standards
  • Ensures the timely and accurate execution of all administrative functions, including personnel documentation, timekeeping records, scheduling coordination, contract compliance reports and internal systems update in alignment with company standards.
  • Successfully negotiate problem resolution regarding contracting specifications and performance.
  • Adheres to and enforces occupational safety procedures, to include being an awareness ambassador for Safety/Loss Prevention.
  • Responsible for meeting established KPIs, including contract compliance, employee engagement scores, and service quality benchmarks.
  • Other duties as assigned.
