title: Executive Director of Grants and Development
description:
The Executive Director of Grants and Development is responsible for securing funding to support Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch’s (YBGR) mission of Caring People, Preparing Youth for Life. This role combines strategic fundraising leadership with hands-on grant writing and donor engagement. The ideal candidate will be a skilled communicator, relationship builder, and project manager who thrives in a mission-driven environment.

The Executive Director of Grants and Development will collaborate with leadership at YBGR and the Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch Foundation to identify grant and gift prospects, implement fundraising strategies, and ensure accurate donor engagement through research, communication, and reporting.

Starting Salary Range: $4,333.36 - $4,877.23 bi-weekly. Salary reflects steps 1-5 of an 11-step pay schedule. The starting salary will be determined based on the applicant’s education and relevant experience.

Daily and Monthly Responsibilities:

  1. Grant Writing & Management
  • Research, identify, and qualify grant opportunities from foundations, corporations, and government sources.
  • Prepare compelling proposals, letters of inquiry, and supporting documentation.
  • Manage grant calendar, deadlines, and reporting requirements to ensure compliance and timely submissions.
  • Track and analyze grant performance metrics and maintain accurate records in the donor database.
  1. Donor Acquisition
  • Collaborate with the Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch Foundation to conduct donor affinity and capacity research, including local businesses.
  • Contact assigned lapsed and newly acquired grantors and donors to encourage continued engagement.
  • Represent Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch at community organizations and events to share the mission and build relationships.
  • Meet with local businesses to present YBGR’s mission and solicit contributions.
  1. Donor Cultivation
  • Schedule and conduct visits with private donors, grantors, foundations, and businesses, complete follow-up visits as appropriate.
  • Coordinate and lead tours at YBGR for interested donors and business representatives.
  • Partner with Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch Foundation to identify and cultivate donors; maintain and manage a priority donor list of 100+ prospects based on linkage, interest, and capacity.
  • Identify potential planned givers among donors and communicate with the Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch Foundation.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with grantors and donors through calls, emails, and written correspondence.
  • Assist the Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch Foundation with newsletter content and contribute to video and radio marketing/public relations messaging, as needed.
  • Assess donor interest and capacity; steward relationships to promote trust, respect, and deeper involvement.
  • Ensure donor recognition aligns with individual preferences.
  1. Professional Knowledge & Representation
  • Demonstrate understanding of philanthropic principles and evidence-based practices in donor research, acquisition, segmentation, and moves management.
  • Demonstrate effective grant writing resulting in successful acquisition of grants.
  • Learn and effectively communicate YBGR’s mission, history, treatment philosophy, and services.
  1. Meetings & Collaboration
  • Participate in regular meetings with YBGR and Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch Foundation staff in order to meet shared goals and objectives.
  • Contribute to ongoing evaluation of fundraising strategies to maximize income and minimize expenses.
  1. Administrative & Reporting
  • Develop annual fundraising goals and monitor progress toward targets.
  • Prepare reports for leadership and board on fundraising performance and opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance with ethical fundraising standards and donor confidentiality.
  • Update donor records and maintain accurate reports of activities and outcomes, in coordination with the Yellowstone Boys and Girls Ranch Foundation.
  1. Organizational Engagement
  • Model YBGR’s mission and values in all interactions.
  • Adhere to organizational policies, systems, safety requirements, and procedures.
  • Take initiative to identify problems and propose solutions.
  • Participate in professional organizations and training as needed.
  • Support organizational strategic goals and PQI initiatives through individual and team contributions.
  • Represent the organization professionally to external stakeholders.
  • Engage in monthly supervision/coaching meetings with your supervisor.
  • Demonstrate fairness and respect with an understanding of donor backgrounds and life-experiences.
  • Complete required training relevant to the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Business Performance Director
description:
Career Category

Corporate Services

Job Description

The Director, Business Performance leads planning, integrating portfolio planning and transparency, performance and value measurement, financial management, organizational effectiveness, and change enablement. The Director partners with Corporate Affairs leaders and enabling teams, particularly Business Performance Data, Analytics and Process Intelligence, to provide a clear view of operational commitments, organizational effectiveness and transformation work, and to develop insights on priorities, performance, risks, value, budgets, and capacity that inform leadership decisions that help Corporate Affairs execute priorities and continuously improve how it operates.


The Director establishes the governance and operating routines that help leaders assess progress, manage dependencies and trade-offs, and act on emerging risks and opportunities. Working with transformation project teams, the Director supports portfolio-level coordination and organizational change while project teams retain accountability for project delivery. The Director also leads the Business Performance team and advances selected process redesign, learning enablement and use of technology, AI, and data improvements that strengthen Corporate Affairs’ outcomes and productivity.


Business Performance & Operational Excellence

  • Establish tools, processes, and governance routines that provide Corporate Affairs leaders with visibility into operational commitments and transformation initiatives, including progress, outcomes, dependencies, risks, and capacity needs, to support prioritization and timely decisions.
  • Establish a performance and value measurement approach, including OKRs, KPIs, productivity, and process intelligence insights, in partnership with the Business Performance Data, Analytics and Process Intelligence team.
  • Provide leaders with practical, integrated insights on performance, risks, budget, and capacity to inform priorities, trade-offs, and investment choices.
  • Develop practical mechanisms to identify performance gaps and support corrective action.
  • Track adoption, capability maturity, process effectiveness and stakeholder experience.
  • Strengthen financial and budget management practices across Corporate Affairs, including planning, forecasting, and review of spend and capacity in relation to priorities and expected value.
  • Use data and feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Transformation, Technology & Capability Building

  • Lead implementation and adoption of new processes, platforms, AI-enabled tools, systems and ways of working.
  • Partner with Technology and other enabling teams on selected process redesign and technology-, AI-, and data-enabled improvements, process architecture, workflow design, defining expected outcomes and measures of adoption, value, and productivity.
  • Create process documentation, standard operating procedures and practical implementation guides and improve access to tools, templates, standards, playbooks and best practices.
  • Develop change plans, stakeholder maps, communications, training and reinforcement activities.
  • Help teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and how their work will be affected.
  • Establish feedback loops to identify adoption barriers and improve implementation.
  • Support successful pilots as they move into broader use across Corporate Affairs.
  • Provide ongoing “care and feeding” to sustain adoption and performance after launch.
  • Lead, develop, and align the Business Performance team, setting clear accountabilities and coordinating its work with enabling teams and Corporate Affairs leaders.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate innovation intake, prioritization, implementation support and knowledge sharing.
  • Maintain an innovation directory, community of practice or similar mechanism to connect teams to proven ideas and tools.
  • Bring relevant internal and external innovation insights into Corporate Affairs.
  • Lead After Action Reviews and post-mortems, translating lessons learned into process improvements, capability development and targeted upskilling.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize, simplify and improve the “Amgen experience” across Corporate Affairs teams.

Functional Skills:

Must-Have Skills:

  • Business Performance & Organizational Effectiveness: Ability to diagnose operational needs, develop solutions, and implement improvements that strengthen organizational effectiveness.
  • Program & Project Management: Ability to independently manage complex, cross-functional workstreams, balance competing priorities, and drive execution.
  • Transformation & Change: Experience implementing technology, AI-enabled capabilities, processes, or new ways of working and supporting sustained adoption.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Ability to advise stakeholders, navigate complexity, build alignment, and influence outcomes without formal authority.

Good-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with AI, automation, or technology-enabled transformation.
  • Experience developing learning or capability-building programs.
  • Experience with governance, knowledge management, or self-service capabilities.
  • Experience in Corporate Affairs, communications, or a complex global function.

title: Proposal Administrator
description:
The Proposal Administrator provides high-quality administrative, coordination and document-management support throughout the opportunity and proposal lifecycle. The role helps the Work Winning and technical teams deliver compliant, accurate and professional submissions for Expressions of Interest (EOIs), Pre-Qualification Questionnaires (PQQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), tenders and other client opportunities.

The role is responsible for maintaining reliable bid information, managing tender communications and client portals, coordinating standard corporate content, and supporting submissions in accordance with client requirements, internal governance and agreed deadlines.

1. Proposal and bid administration
• Provide day-to-day administrative support across multiple opportunities and proposals.
• Set up and maintain bid folders, document structures, templates, schedules, trackers and submission files.
• Coordinate inputs from technical, commercial and corporate contributors against agreed deadlines.
• Compile, format and consolidate proposal documents in accordance with company templates and client instructions.
• Support final compliance checks, confirming that forms, declarations, attachments and supporting documents are complete.
• Maintain auditable records of submitted documents, approvals and final correspondence.
2. Client portals and tender communications
• Monitor the team inbox and client procurement or tender portals, and distribute communications promptly to relevant team members.
• Register opportunities and download tender documents, addenda, clarifications and submission instructions.
• Submit technical queries and clarification requests prepared by the bid team within stipulated deadlines.
• Coordinate portal registrations, access permissions and user information with internal stakeholders.
• Upload proposal documents under the direction of the responsible Proposal or Bid Manager and retain submission confirmations.
3. EOI and PQQ coordination
• Coordinate routine EOI and PQQ responses using approved corporate information and standard content.
• Gather required information from Finance, HR, technical teams and other business functions.
• Coordinate signatures, declarations, certificates, policies and supporting documents.
• Maintain completed prequalification content for efficient and controlled reuse.
4. Proposal development support
• Support proposal kick-off activities by preparing folders, templates, response schedules and coordination trackers.
• Collect technical inputs, CVs, project experience, case studies, organisation charts and supporting evidence.
• Help contributors comply with page limits, templates, naming conventions and submission requirements.
• Provide formatting, proofreading, version-control and quality-check support before internal reviews and final submission.
• Support post-submission archiving, outcome recording, feedback capture and lessons learned.
5. Opportunity and bid tracking
• Maintain accurate opportunity and submission records in the bid tracker and relevant business systems.
• Record key data such as client, project, market, value, stage, submission deadline, status and responsible team members.
• Track milestones including registration, clarification, review and submission dates.
• Support regular reporting on live and upcoming opportunities and follow up on missing or outdated information.
6. Content and knowledge libraries
• Maintain controlled libraries of staff CVs, project sheets, case studies, standard company information, policies, certificates and approved proposal content.
• Work with contributors to obtain updated project and personnel information.
• Apply clear naming conventions, version control and archive arrangements.
• Remove or archive superseded material to reduce the risk of outdated content being used.
7. Stakeholder coordination
• Act as a reliable coordination point between Work Winning, technical teams, Finance, HR, IT, leadership and other stakeholders.
• Communicate requirements and deadlines clearly, follow up professionally and escalate risks or missing information promptly.
• Support collaboration across offices, geographies and time zones while handling commercially sensitive information appropriately.

Job Description:

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:


The work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of USSTRATCOM. USSTRATCOM is responsible for strategic deterrence, nuclear operations, and enterprise IT services essential to national security. SCITLS supports enterprise wide systems, platforms, and operational capabilities. As an A&E Engineer, you will contribute to the design, definition, integration, and sustainment of system architectures that support mission critical environments and ensure operational continuity across the enterprise.


You will play a crucial role in providing support in the following areas:

• Designing and defining system architectures for new or existing computer systems, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with mission requirements.

• Supporting A&E engineering efforts by developing, integrating, and validating architectural solutions across systems, networks, applications, and data environments.

• Analyzing operational and business requirements to design efficient, functional system architectures and integration points.

• Supporting system deployments, upgrades, and configuration activities across multi OS environments (Linux, Windows).

• Developing detailed documentation, architecture diagrams, system specifications, and operational standards.

• Troubleshooting complex system issues across infrastructure, middleware, database, and application layers to restore full functionality.

• Supporting system testing, validation, and acceptance activities to ensure solution readiness and compliance.

• Collaborating with software developers, network engineers, cybersecurity teams, and project managers to ensure seamless system integration.

• Conducting engineering assessments to improve performance, reliability, and operational efficiency across enterprise systems.

• Maintaining system software, platform components, and data interactions to ensure consistent and stable operation.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

• Education: BA/BS (additional experience may substitute).

• Experience: 15+ years of related professional experience in architecture, engineering, or technical leadership.

• Required Certifications: ITIL Foundations v4/v5 Certificate (or ability to obtain within 9 months) and DoW 8140 Certification (or ability to obtain within 6 months)

• Must have a current/active Top Secret clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and a CI Poly

• Ability to provide on-call and after-hours support, as required

• Location: Offutt AFB, NE


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in systems architecture, architecture and engineering (A&E), large-scale solution design, and end-to-end system lifecycle support, including development of architecture diagrams, deployment and configuration documentation, engineering specifications, and technical implementation plans.

• Proficiency with SQL, Java, Python, Linux, system software, infrastructure troubleshooting, and operational support in complex enterprise environments.

• Hands-on experience with Linux enterprise technologies, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 8.x and later, Red Hat OpenShift, and Ansible Automation Platform (AAP).

• Experience designing, deploying, administering, and troubleshooting Kubernetes-based environments, including Rancher/RKE, Helm charts, and related orchestration tools.

• Familiarity with container technologies, including Docker, Podman, container image management, and containerized application deployment.

• Experience developing and maintaining automation solutions using Ansible, Python, Jenkins, scripting, and related continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools.

• Knowledge of database interactions, reporting workflows, application integrations, data flows, middleware frameworks, and system documentation.

• Strong analytical, testing, troubleshooting, and diagnostic skills supporting complex systems, infrastructure, and operational environments.

• Familiarity with HTML, scripting languages, web technologies, and enterprise application integration patterns.

• Cross-functional experience or working knowledge in Windows environments, networking, cybersecurity, and infrastructure operations.

• Experience with geospatial and mapping software, including Environmental Systems Research Institute (ESRI) tools and platforms.

• Familiarity with enterprise logging, monitoring, and analytics platforms, including Splunk, Logstash, Kibana, and Elastic Stack (ELK).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, software development, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and mission operations teams.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
description:
About REAL

REAL is building an AI Execution Platform for enterprise real estate organizations.

Our platform transforms fragmented business and financial data into connected intelligence, enabling customers to automate complex workflows, improve operational accuracy, and make better business decisions.

At REAL, you’ll work with cutting-edge AI technology, enterprise customers, and a product that’s redefining how commercial real estate organizations operate.

REAL Values

Ownership: We take responsibility and move decisively.
Clarity: We simplify complexity to deliver meaningful impact.
Accuracy: Precision matters in everything we build.
Velocity: We work with urgency and intent.
Partnership: We collaborate closely with customers and teammates.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a talented, curious, and ambitious UX/UI Designer to join our growing team and help shape the future of AI-powered enterprise software for enterprise real estate organizations.

This role is perfect for a designer who loves solving complex UX challenges and making data-heavy products simple, thinks beyond the screen, and is excited to explore new technologies, experiment with AI tools, and continuously grow.

You’ll work at the intersection of design, product, and technology, collaborating closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and teams across the company, including Marketing and Sales.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong UX thinking, creativity, and attention to detail with a hands-on, can-do attitude. Someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership, and is just as excited about solving a challenging product flow as contributing to other creative initiatives across the company.

If you’re a smart, proactive designer who loves learning, moving fast, and making a real impact, we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

  • Design end-to-end product experiences, from user flows and wireframes to polished UI and developer handoff.
  • Simplify complex workflows and data-heavy processes, including dashboards, analytics, and data management, into intuitive, user-friendly experiences.
  • Apply strong UX thinking to solve problems, explore edge cases, and shape product decisions.
  • Create high-quality visual assets for Marketing, Sales, and other business needs, including presentations, campaigns, and digital content.
  • Explore AI tools and new technologies to accelerate design, prototyping, and creativity, and use vibe coding to amplify your designs and bring them to life as working prototypes.
  • Collaborate across teams, take ownership, and bring creative ideas to life in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio showcasing UX thinking and visual design skills.
  • Strong UX and product intuition, with the ability to simplify complex workflows and solve problems creatively.
  • Excellent UX/UI design skills, including wireframing, prototyping, and design systems, using modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma and v0.
  • Strong visual design skills and versatility across product, marketing, and other creative projects.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI tools, new technologies, and continuous learning.
  • A proactive, hands-on, collaborative mindset, with strong communication skills, attention to detail, and fluency in Hebrew and English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing complex B2B SaaS or enterprise products.
  • Experience with AI-powered products, AI design tools, or rapid prototyping tools such as Lovable or similar.
  • Experience working on data-heavy products, dashboards, analytics, data management, or complex business workflows.
  • Experience contributing to marketing design, brand initiatives, or other cross-functional creative projects.
  • Experience working in fast-paced startups or dynamic product teams.
  • Hands-on experience turning designs into working prototypes with vibe coding, AI coding tools, or light front-end coding.
  • Knowledge of the real estate, construction, or architecture world.

title: Senior Manager, Organizational & Talent Development
description:
At SWEP, we believe our future rest on give more energy than we take – to our planet and to our people.

As the world´s leading supplier of efficient heat transfer technology, we are driving the conversion to sustainable energy usage in heat transfer. We are dedicated to constantly creating more from less energy, material, and space. We are a growing company and a part of the Dover Corporation family. We are dedicated to supporting our customers with the optimal solutions and we believe in close, rewarding partnerships. We are represented in more than 50 countries and have production facilities in Sweden, USA, Slovakia, China and Malaysia.

For us at SWEP, it's more than just a job, it´s a commitment to making a difference and an impact by finding new ways to make energy last longer – globally and locally. We are striving for record-breaking growth and are looking for individuals who think like entrepreneurs, have an open mind, care about the environment, and want to inspire and be inspired. Come and join us!

Senior Manager Talent & Organizational Development

Location: SWEP Headquarters, Landskrona, Sweden


SWEP ensures efficient heat transfer where less means more. Since 1983, our innovative brazed plate heat exchangers have supported HVACR and industrial applications worldwide. As part of Dover Corporation, we help customers make more efficient use of energy. Make a difference. Visit swepgroup.com.


Help build the leadership and capabilities behind SWEP’s growth


Do you enjoy helping people grow and turning talent strategy into practical business results? We are looking for a Manager Talent & Organizational Development to build the leadership and organizational capabilities SWEP needs to deliver its business strategy.


In this global role, you will lead our Talent & Organizational Development Center of Expertise. You will set global standards and work with leaders and HR colleagues to put them into practice locally. Your work will connect talent and learning priorities with business needs and measurable results.


You will report to the VP Human Resources and lead the Learning & Development Specialist and, from 1 January 2027, a part-time HR Student (0.5 FTE). You will work closely with Executive Leadership, HR Business Partners, regional and BU HR, Communications, HR Information Solutions and Dover Total Talent.


What you’ll do:


  • Lead SWEP’s global talent and organizational development strategy, translating business priorities into a focused annual roadmap.
  • Lead talent and succession reviews for key leadership and critical specialist roles. Strengthen career paths, mentoring and internal mobility, linking succession actions to workforce planning.
  • Build an integrated approach to leadership and learning through SWEP Academy and Dover programs. Develop scalable learning, including production onboarding, and use digital, immersive and AI tools where they have a sound business case.
  • Own global performance-management, recruitment and selection standards, together with the global onboarding minimum standard. Support consistent local implementation and adoption of relevant Workday processes.
  • Lead employer branding with Communications and use workforce insights to improve attraction and retention.
  • Use myVoice, roundtables and other feedback to drive improvements in employee experience and inclusion. Support leaders in building change capability and organizational readiness.
  • Lead and develop your team. Manage the portfolio’s priorities, milestones, budgets, vendors and risks, with regular follow-up on adoption and business benefits.
  • Own data definitions and quality within your processes. Partner with HR Information Solutions on Workday, Power BI and people analytics to turn insights into action.

What success looks like:


Your work will strengthen successor readiness and internal talent pipelines, improve manager effectiveness and help employees apply new skills at work. You will demonstrate progress through better adoption of global processes, improvements in employee feedback and clear evidence that the portfolio delivers its intended benefits within budget.


Who you are:


You combine strategic thinking with the ability to get things done. You can challenge and coach senior leaders, set clear priorities and build commitment across functions and cultures. You are comfortable balancing global consistency with local needs, and you use evidence to assess what works. Your approach reflects high integrity and inclusive leadership.


Your background:

  • A university degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Organizational Development or another relevant field.
  • Substantial international HR experience, typically 10+ years, including significant responsibility for talent, leadership or organizational development.
  • Experience owning global programs and working with executive management in an international matrix organization. Industrial experience is preferred.
  • Strong commercial judgement, organizational development skills and the ability to lead change through influence.
  • Confidence using people analytics and digital learning approaches to improve decisions and delivery. Familiarity with Workday, Power BI or immersive learning is valuable.
  • Clear communication and relationship-building skills, with fluency in spoken and written English.

Why join SWEP?


At SWEP, you will have the opportunity to shape how a global industrial business develops its people. You will work directly with senior leaders, collaborate across SWEP and Dover, and lead a small team with a broad global remit. The role combines strategic ownership with practical delivery, giving you the opportunity to see your work improve leadership and business performance.


If you are motivated by helping people grow and building an organization’s capability to succeed, we would love to hear from you.


Sounds interesting?
